note.zh: 官方代码确认闭环任务。这里保留 Scout 的局部协议，原论文训练配置未逐项锁定。
note.en: Official code confirms the task; this review bounds Scout without pinning every original training configuration.

note.zh: 平台可提供可核验任务；这里只接入 Leduc，不把该能力传播给其他牌类。对手与评估局数仍需固定。
note.en: The platform provides a documented task. Only Leduc is mapped; opponents and evaluation counts remain configurable.

note.zh: 主评测闭环、输入和完成目标已核验。其余五款游戏尚未在本条逐一展开任务。
note.en: Closed-loop inputs and completion objective are verified; the other five games are not expanded in this review.

note.zh: 官方环境、教程、观测和奖励归一化已确认；当前版本与 ICML 2024 实验版本仍需锁定对应关系。
note.en: Official environment, tutorial, observations and score normalization are confirmed; release alignment with the ICML 2024 experiments remains to be pinned.

note.zh: 从四类任务中展开 Building 的完整评估范围，其他任务不继承其空间能力标签。
note.en: Building is expanded from the four task families; its spatial tags are not inherited by the others.

note.zh: 采用官方成就成功率与几何均值协议；不以训练 reward 替代主评分。
note.en: Uses official achievement success rates and geometric score rather than training reward.

note.zh: 代码确认河流、巨石、终点和预算；任务可纳入文献图，训练种子与算法比较设置需另行固定。
note.en: Code confirms river, boulders, goal and budget; training seeds and comparative algorithm settings still need fixing.

note.zh: 仅展开一个有明确收益、代价、输入和动作协议的安全 RL 场景。
note.en: Expands one safe-RL scenario with explicit reward, cost, inputs and actions.

note.zh: 采用原论文符号实体、多离散动作与 holdout solve rate；未将所有物理关卡都标为记忆。
note.en: Uses symbolic entities, multi-discrete actions and holdout solve rate; fully observed physics tasks are not labeled memory tests.

note.zh: 原始帧、定时按键和检查点评分已确认；其他公测游戏与隐藏集不继承此任务标签。
note.en: Raw frames, timed actions and checkpoint scoring are confirmed; other public games and the hidden set do not inherit these tags.

note.zh: 使用官方跨域序列及持续学习指标；遗忘指模型学习保留，不等同回合内记忆能力。
note.en: Uses the documented sequence and continual-learning metrics; forgetting is learning retention, not within-episode memory.

note.zh: 原文给出输入、动作、指标、留出等级和重复实验设置；四场景共享评测设计合并为一个单位。
note.en: The paper specifies inputs, actions, metrics, holdout levels and repeats; shared evaluation across four scenarios forms one unit.

note.zh: 方法论文有真实对局与分难度胜率，可接入文献任务；地图、种子和调用预算未完全标准化。
note.en: This method paper includes real games and difficulty-specific win rates; maps, seeds and API budgets are not fully standardized.

note.zh: 官方任务明确隔离长期空间记忆，观测、动作与步数预算均可核验。
note.en: The official task explicitly targets long-term spatial memory with documented interface and episode budgets.

note.zh: 仓库确认 Clean Up 场景，主论文索引确认评分。原比赛配置版本与最终隐藏伙伴细节未完全重建。
note.en: Repository confirms Clean Up scenarios and the indexed primary paper confirms scoring. Original configuration/version and final hidden partners are not fully reconstructed.

note.zh: 原论文明确 Clean Up 的机制与群体评分；这里只建立该代表任务，不复制所有 substrate 能力。
note.en: The paper specifies Clean Up mechanisms and population scoring; only this representative task is mapped.

note.zh: 官方代码给出隐藏观测、翻牌动作、奖励与截断规则；以该代表游戏接入记忆图。
note.en: Official code specifies hidden observations, flip actions, rewards and truncation; this representative game enters the memory map.

note.zh: 补入原始 ALE 的实际 RL 评估协议，并将代表子游戏明确挂接；未把所有 ROM 都算作已核验任务。
note.en: Registered the original ALE RL evaluation and explicit representative subgames, without treating every ROM as reviewed.

note.zh: 补入原始 SMAC 协作微操协议，能力范围限定为单位协作和控制。
note.en: Registered original SMAC cooperative micromanagement, scoped to unit coordination and control.

note.zh: 从平台的实际小游戏评估中接入 BuildMarines；没有把人类回放预测作为游玩任务。
note.en: Registered BuildMarines from the platform’s interactive mini-game evaluation, excluding replay prediction.

note.zh: 接入有明确成功判定的指令执行协议，空间关系依据来自 PutNextLocal。
note.en: Registered instruction execution with explicit success criteria; spatial-reasoning attribution comes from PutNextLocal.

note.zh: 已确认 Leduc 的实际策略学习与评估协议；保留平台代表任务身份，未核验全部 OpenSpiel 游戏。
note.en: Confirmed actual Leduc policy learning/evaluation while retaining its status as a representative platform task; not all OpenSpiel games reviewed.

note.zh: 补入 random_maze 明确的交互任务；未固定的实验预算作为限制，不再因此留空任务。
note.en: Registered the explicit random_maze interaction task; unspecified experimental budgets remain a limitation rather than excluding the task.

note.zh: 补入赛事文献中明确的单人规划协议；该任务仍保持合集身份，未虚构未公开赛季游戏名单。
note.en: Registered the documented single-player competition protocol as a collection, without inventing private seasonal game lists.

note.zh: 已核验任务、控制、楼层指标及泛化划分，并区分 25 层实测原型和 100 层设计。
note.en: Verified tasks, controls, floor metrics and generalization splits, distinguishing the evaluated 25-floor prototype from the 100-floor design.

note.zh: 数据集论文确实包含闭环 RL/模仿学习基线；接入 Treechop 与 Navigate，明确最佳训练窗口的报告口径。
note.en: The dataset paper includes closed-loop RL/imitation baselines; registered Treechop and Navigate with the best-training-window reporting scope.

note.zh: 补入论文明确评估的 Sokoban 子游戏；仅使用清楚的逐关卡协议，跨关卡划分待核对代码。
note.en: Registered the explicitly evaluated Sokoban subgame using the clear per-level protocol; cross-level splits still require code reconciliation.

note.zh: 补入 ELF 实际 Mini-RTS 完整对局实验，并说明宏动作及信息不对称。
note.en: Registered ELF’s actual full-game Mini-RTS experiments with explicit macro-action and information-asymmetry limits.

note.zh: 从官方仓库确认具体示例而非仅列平台功能；保留原论文访问失败和示例性质的说明。
note.en: Confirmed a concrete official example rather than platform features, retaining the paper-access failure and example-only scope.

note.zh: 竞技对战和 RPG 速通拆为两个游戏专属任务，分别记录指标与 harness 边界。
note.en: Split competitive battles and RPG speedrunning into game-specific units with separate metrics and harness limits.

note.zh: 确认这是完整闭环对抗评测；能力依据落在规则应用与策略，而非为所有生成子游戏复制复杂能力。
note.en: Confirmed closed-loop adversarial evaluation; capability attribution is limited to rule application and strategy rather than copied complex capabilities for all generated games.

note.zh: 接入固定 A0 的已定义消融协议；严格区分完成对局统计、自动难度爬升及骨干迁移。
note.en: Registered the defined fixed-A0 ablation, separating completed-run statistics from auto-ladder and cross-backbone probes.

note.zh: 已从官方 LLM 仓库确认真实对战、状态动作与回合指标；与尚未完全核验的 2026 赛事计分规则分开。
note.en: Confirmed real matches, observation/action interfaces and round metrics in the official LLM repository, separately from incompletely reviewed 2026 competition scoring.

note.zh: 商业游戏和 Lua 模组依赖；多轮结果仅限附录指定任务，未独立运行。
note.en: Commercial game and Lua mod required; multi-round results cover specified appendix tasks only; not independently run.

note.zh: 符号状态接口；不等同于像素端到端游玩，Sokoban 重点为基本能力而非最难关卡。
note.en: Symbolic interface; not end-to-end pixel gameplay. Sokoban targets basic competence rather than hardest levels.

note.zh: CWMB 含非游戏连续控制；RTFM 固定手册并冻结怪物，不代表完整 RTFM。
note.en: CWMB includes nongame continuous control. RTFM fixes its manual and freezes monsters, so it is not full RTFM.

note.zh: 100k 训练交互预算；想象内策略学习不等同于原游戏真实交互。
note.en: 100k training interactions; imagination training must be distinguished from real-emulator interaction.

note.zh: 100k 训练交互预算；想象内策略学习不等同于原游戏真实交互。
note.en: 100k training interactions; imagination training must be distinguished from real-emulator interaction.

note.zh: 各合集只关联已核验家族；不把所有 Atari 游戏自动标为记忆测试。
note.en: Map verified families only; Atari games do not automatically become memory tests.

note.zh: 100k 训练交互预算；想象内策略学习不等同于原游戏真实交互。
note.en: 100k training interactions; imagination training must be distinguished from real-emulator interaction.

note.zh: Montezuma 为限定取钥匙任务；修正 OCAtari 对象提取，不是原始图像全游戏通关。
note.en: Montezuma is a bounded key task, using corrected OCAtari extraction rather than full-game raw-pixel completion.

note.zh: LLM 生成课程、RL 执行游戏；不能当成 LLM 直接游玩成绩。
note.en: LLMs generate curricula while RL plays; these are not direct LLM gameplay scores.

note.zh: 有限前瞻、符号对象及检查点回滚；预测精度不等于更强通关，非整游戏评价。
note.en: Bounded lookahead, symbolic objects and checkpoint rollback; predictive fidelity is not equivalent to stronger full-game play.

note.zh: 手工构造的因果反例与 LLM 合成实验分开；单种规则缺失不支持所有模型普遍失效。
note.en: Separate hand-built causal witnesses from LLM-synthesis experiments; one omitted rule does not establish universal failure.

note.zh: 公开游戏并非私有验证集；单次运行波动大；文中隔离旧版泄漏结果，官方评分窗口另有约束。
note.en: Public games are not private validation; high run variability. Vulnerable historical runs are excluded and official scorecard windows impose different constraints.

note.zh: 闭环改造是在线环境交互；单次提交产物不等于键鼠游玩。原版关卡、战斗或多玩家协作均未由这些实验覆盖。EMNLP 接收为作者主来源声明。
note.en: Closed-loop refinement interacts with the environment; one-shot artifact submission is not keyboard/mouse play. Original campaign, combat and multiplayer coordination are outside these experiments. EMNLP acceptance is an author-primary claim.

note.zh: 提供方块与结构化 MCP 状态，不测资源生存或像素控制；干预增益不能解释为纯粹单项能力因果差距。主论文预印本，仓库称 ICLR RSI Workshop Spotlight。
note.en: Blocks and structured MCP state are supplied; resource survival and pixel control are excluded. Intervention gains do not isolate pure causal ability gaps. Preprint with author-repository workshop claim.

note.zh: 真实 Minecraft 与理想化移动仿真须分开。官方仓库明确框架尚不复现实验；世界资产、精确种子和 WISE 可执行评测适配器待完整发布。
note.en: Real Minecraft and idealized-motion results must remain separate. The official repository says its framework does not reproduce experiments yet; world assets, exact seeds and executable WISE adapters await full release.

note.zh: TSR 在文中描述为方块级建造质量；不能与二元整任务成功率混同。公开仓库未定位，高协作蓝图、种子与完整执行预算待可下载配置核对。
note.en: TSR is described as block-level construction quality and is not interchangeable with binary episode success. No public repository located; downloadable high-coordination blueprints, seeds and full execution budgets remain unconfirmed.

note.zh: 仅一个场景；模型接收不同编码的等价 ASCII/深度信息，未给 LLM 原始视觉；回合数 3/5/10 不同，总击杀不能直接作等预算排名。训练为人类示范监督学习。
note.en: One scenario; LLMs receive text ASCII/depth rather than raw vision. Episode counts differ (3/5/10), so cumulative frags are not equal-budget rankings. The small model uses supervised human demonstrations.

note.zh: 单次随机世界案例，不能形成重复种子的稳定模型排行榜；没有固定 API 预算及跨种子成功率。
note.en: One random-world case study, not a repeated-seed model ranking; fixed API budget and cross-seed success rate are absent.

note.zh: 不要把 MineDojo 的 3,142 个可用任务当作本文全部实测；训练 rollout 与九个评测任务分离。VAB 与 MineDojo 控制协议不同，需分别读取配置。
note.en: MineDojo’s 3,142 available tasks are not all evaluated here. Training rollouts exclude the nine test tasks. MineDojo and VAB have different interfaces and require separate configurations.

note.zh: 12 主链与 7 校准/探针链分开；目标世界重置后只传递声明 artifact。五配对种子的区间较宽，不能把图支持的所有能力当成实测提升。
note.en: Twelve primary and seven calibration/probe chains remain separate. Target worlds reset and only declared artifacts transfer. Five paired seeds yield broad intervals; graph-supported capabilities do not establish measured improvement.

note.zh: Wiki/配方是知识源，不是新采集的人类轨迹集；网页 DOI 本轮无法取回，arXiv v2 明确 KBS 接收与关联 DOI。
note.en: Wiki/recipes are knowledge sources rather than new human demonstrations. DOI landing page was inaccessible this pass; arXiv v2 confirms KBS acceptance and related DOI.

note.zh: 监督训练的专用Transformer，不应默认标为通用LLM或RL。固定数据与引擎/搜索预算分别控制；本轮未复现实验。
note.en: Specialist supervised transformers are not automatically LLM or RL agents. Dataset, engine and search budgets must be controlled separately; no execution reproduced here.

note.zh: Maia-3人类模仿与Leela-CF竞技模型使用不同数据与目标；不能合成一个未经定义的统一成绩。
note.en: Maia-3 human emulation and Leela-CF strength use different datasets/objectives and must not be merged into an undefined unified score.

note.zh: 本轮已核对限定任务的目标、观测/动作与原始指标并接入文献覆盖；保留 partial，具体配置和范围限制见各单元。未复现实验，不代表 Arena 已可运行。
note.en: This pass verifies bounded task goals, observations/actions and original metrics for literature coverage. Partial status retains the configuration and scope limits in each unit. No experiments were reproduced and Arena runtime availability is not implied.

note.zh: 全文§3与算法1确认固定查询/提交协议、成功率和成功回合平均轮数。已核验集合级协议，无需把474个规则实例伪装成474款独立游戏；删除仅因累积历史而附加的记忆标签。 本轮归属复核：保留474个程序化推理游戏的共同查询协议；集合跨四种数据结构与三种推理模式，未将结构标签当作独立电子游戏。
note.en: Sections 3 and Algorithm 1 verify query/submit interaction, success rate, and turns on successful episodes. The suite-level protocol is verified without treating 474 rule instances as distinct games; the unsupported memory tag is removed. Routing review: Retain the shared query protocol for 474 generated reasoning games; four data structures and three inference modes are not discrete videogames.

note.zh: 全文和附录确认100游戏共同交互协议、120次调用预算和人类归一化指标；只登记集合协议，不向各游戏复制认知能力标签。 本轮归属复核：保留100个生成实现的键盘交互协议；App Store/Steam游戏是生成灵感来源，不能将原作名称直接视为评测对象。
note.en: Full text and appendices establish the common 100-game protocol, 120-call budget and human-normalized metrics; only the suite protocol is registered. Routing review: Retain the keyboard protocol for 100 generated implementations; App Store/Steam source titles are inspirations, not the evaluated originals.

note.zh: 全文表1与附录D.3定位2048独立协议、1000步上限和归一化合并分；明确游戏内时间约束与反思条件。其余14游戏不在本次能力单元范围。
note.en: Table 1 and appendix D.3 establish the 2048 protocol, 1000-step cap and normalized merge score, with time and reflection conditions explicit; other games are outside this unit.

note.zh: 全文§3.5/§4.1确认状态验证器、100动作预算及推理时暂停。保留已核实的Minecraft克隆采集和Flappy Bird两单位，不把其能力推广至其余32游戏。
note.en: Sections 3.5/4.1 verify state-based scoring, a 100-action budget, and paused inference. Retain the Minecraft-clone collection and Flappy Bird units only; do not propagate capabilities to 32 other games.

note.zh: 已读取CVPR全文§2.2和图5：10游戏30任务、每任务5次、人类判定成功、统一手柄与暂停执行均明确。游戏标题未命名是数据披露限制，不否定该匿名协议可核验。 本轮归属复核：正文§2.2仅明确10款商业游戏、30项任务与类型分布，未给可核验的逐游戏名称；不凭截图猜测游戏。
note.en: CVPR Section 2.2 and Figure 5 specify ten games, 30 tasks, five rollouts, human success judgments, unified gamepad controls, and paused execution. Undisclosed titles limit attribution but not protocol verification. Routing review: Section 2.2 establishes ten commercial games and thirty tasks, but not a verifiable title-by-task list; screenshots are not used to guess titles.

note.zh: 已按表 1 的 12 个具体游戏分别绑定任务和指标；不把雷达图全部维度继承给每款游戏。
note.en: Each of the 12 games is mapped to its own Table 1 task and metric; radar-chart dimensions are not copied to every game.

note.zh: GameQA 是从游戏生成的可验证视觉推理训练数据；跨域收益不能视为在 30 款游戏中实际游玩的能力覆盖。
note.en: GameQA is verifiable visual-reasoning training data generated from games; transfer gains do not establish interactive play coverage across the 30 source games.

note.zh: 核验全文Execution及附录A.3/B.1，补500任务、75回复预算和屏幕成功验证；只覆盖Execution，不声称Playthrough轨道已同等核验。 本轮归属复核：仅路由500项Execution任务所在的10款游戏。Link’s Awakening的版本未明确，单列研究环境，不合并到现有DX版本；不纳入Playthrough和额外实现游戏。
note.en: Verified Execution and appendices A.3/B.1: 500 tasks, 75-response budgets and screen-based success checks; Playthrough is outside this reviewed scope. Routing review: Route only the ten games supporting 500 Execution tasks. Link’s Awakening edition is unspecified and is not merged with the DX node; Playthrough and extra implementations are excluded.

detail.zh: 在线 Minecraft 的具体可执行动作格式与执行器尚未公开定位；项目仓库仍把在线环境列为发布计划，论文键绑定表属于数据注释，不能替代在线接口。
detail.en: The executable online Minecraft action format and executor remain unlocated. The repository lists online environments in its release roadmap; annotation keybindings do not establish the online interface.

note.zh: 在线 Minecraft 的具体可执行动作格式与执行器尚未公开定位；项目仓库仍把在线环境列为发布计划，论文键绑定表属于数据注释，不能替代在线接口。
note.en: The executable online Minecraft action format and executor remain unlocated. The repository lists online environments in its release roadmap; annotation keybindings do not establish the online interface.

note.zh: 本轮已核对限定任务的目标、观测/动作与原始指标并接入文献覆盖；保留 partial，具体配置和范围限制见各单元。未复现实验，不代表 Arena 已可运行。
note.en: This pass verifies bounded task goals, observations/actions and original metrics for literature coverage. Partial status retains the configuration and scope limits in each unit. No experiments were reproduced and Arena runtime availability is not implied.

note.zh: 读取全文§2.3–2.5、§3.1.1，补齐共同动作循环、结果归一化和20局座位平衡；仅集合级单位，未向每子游戏复制能力。 本轮归属复核：表1明确八款实际对局对象；自定义Pong、Surround及Negotiation v2单独建环境，不与Atari版本混同。
note.en: Read Sections 2.3–2.5 and 3.1.1, extracting action loop, normalized outcomes, and 20-match seat balance. Retained one suite-level unit without per-game capability propagation. Routing review: Table 1 identifies the eight actual match environments; custom Pong, Surround and Negotiation v2 remain separate from Atari versions.

note.zh: 附录E.1/E.4补全Aquawar两阶段、固定场景、重试判负和0.7胜率+0.3伤害率；不把AgentBench其它非游戏工具任务算入覆盖。
note.en: Appendices E.1/E.4 specify Aquawar stages, matched scenarios, retry forfeits and 0.7 win-rate + 0.3 damage-rate scoring; non-game AgentBench tasks are excluded.

note.zh: 全文评测与棋类附录补出100局、100步、对手强度和非法动作处理；当前任务单元限象棋子协议，仍挂集合而不冒充全套六环境。
note.en: Full evaluation and chess appendix establish 100 episodes, 100-step limits, opponent strength and invalid-action handling. The unit is scoped to chess, not all six environments.

note.zh: 作者全文补齐 OpenHA 评测协议；收录该方法采用的任务，不视为新建独立 Benchmark。
note.en: Author full text resolves the OpenHA evaluation protocol; these are reused evaluation tasks, not a new independent benchmark.

detail.zh: PMLR 正式 PDF 再次读取失败，OpenReview 两个论文链接均进入验证页；可确认混合高低层动作与既往成功指标，但观测内容及其具体执行映射仍无法核对。
detail.en: The official PMLR PDF again failed to load and both OpenReview paper links required browser verification. Mixed hierarchical actions and previously recorded metrics are known, but observations and their executable mapping remain unverifiable.

note.en: Appendix I.3 separates acquisition success from survival-duration success; this review registers the 500-step food/water choice protocol without mixing in thermal 300-step survival.

note.zh: 全文3.1确认模型输出蓝图矩阵，Mineflayer自动建造；评分含GPT-4.1加权建筑质量与空间问答准确率，非闭环玩家操作。保留研究条目，移出交互游玩能力图。
note.en: Section 3.1 confirms blueprint-matrix output followed by automatic Mineflayer construction. Metrics include GPT-4.1-weighted artifact quality and spatial-QA accuracy, not closed-loop player control; retained as research but excluded from interactive coverage.

note.zh: 全文3.2与附录E/F区分35任务主实验、150任务扩展和MCU-Turbo100任务；本单元限主实验并明确30/10种子。AutoEval与实际环境游玩分开：评分用视频，轨迹由闭环行动产生。
note.en: Section 3.2 and appendices E/F distinguish the 35-task main experiment, 150-task extension and 100-task MCU-Turbo. This unit covers main experiments with explicit 30/10-seed controls; video judging scores trajectories produced by interactive agents.

note.zh: 全文和附录E确认44请求/216子任务及验证器；明确玩家参与修复，限制到已记录的人机协作试验，不将其宣传为全自主记忆测量。
note.en: Full text and appendix E confirm 44 requests/216 subtasks and validators. Human-assisted repair is explicit; scope is the documented mixed-initiative pilot, not autonomous memory measurement.

note.zh: 全文§2.2及附录A确认四个BASALT任务的像素输入、人类成对偏好和留出种子；另补充有显式奖励的ObtainDiamondShovel，不能与人类偏好分混合。
note.en: Section 2.2 and Appendix A verify pixels, human preferences, and held-out seeds for four BASALT tasks. Added ObtainDiamondShovel with explicit rewards, kept separate from preference ratings.

note.zh: 本轮读取全文§4.3，确认交互builder按相对初始网格的块改动F1计分，并按应增删块数加权。NLP澄清F1/MRR@20为独立离线赛道，不纳入units。
note.en: Full-text Section 4.3 confirms builder block-edit F1 relative to the initial grid, weighted by required additions/removals. NLP clarification F1/MRR@20 remains an excluded offline track.

note.zh: 全文3与实验设置、附录A补38角色划分、终端输入、三种子50局及AutoAscend归一化；移除以平台困难度代替能力测量的说法。
note.en: Section 3, experimental setup and appendix A establish 38 character splits, terminal inputs, three seeds/50 episodes and AutoAscend normalization.

note.en: Observation/action sections and appendices A.3–A.4 distinguish PvE Top1 from PvP TrueSkill with 100/1000-match schedules; this competition protocol is distinct from the 2.0 platform.

note.zh: 比赛回顾全文2.1–2.2补四任务、同种子人工配对、TrueSkill标准化及复训预算；仅登记共同评测协议，避免将人类打分视频误当静态问答。
note.en: Competition retrospective sections 2.1–2.2 establish four tasks, matched-seed human comparisons, normalized TrueSkill and retraining budgets; video scoring evaluates actual agent rollouts.

note.zh: 全文4.2核验建造者三类动作接口、固定初/目标态和三项指标；纠正交互澄清在2021仅为未来方向，静态Architect不计入游玩覆盖。
note.en: Section 4.2 verifies three builder action interfaces, fixed initial/target states and three metrics. Interactive clarification was future work in 2021; offline Architect generation is excluded.

note.zh: 全文实验段核验统一tty观察、15亿帧、1024局和10种子；明确人类数据无动作奖励，但文中有在线评测，保留该有限协议。
note.en: Experimental section verifies tty observations, 1.5B frames, 1024 episodes and 10 seeds. Human data lack actions/rewards, but the paper evaluates learned policies online.

note.zh: 作者 PDF 补齐单 Agent 持续采集协议；模拟器支持多 Agent 不等于论文评测了协作。
note.en: Author PDF resolves a single-agent continuing collection protocol; simulator multi-agent support is not evidence of an evaluated coordination task.

note.zh: 全文补齐三款游戏的完整流程分数与视觉—执行接口。记录的是 GameSense 系统闭环任务，不把模块控制归因于裸 VLM。
note.en: Full text supplies complete-flow scores and visual/execution interfaces for three games. These are closed-loop GameSense system tasks, not isolated VLM control.

note.zh: 全文确认DSLE-5只是五首领代表子集，22首领扩展设置不混合。补充重要控制边界：相同存档和动作仍会因游戏内部随机性产生不同轨迹，不能称完全固定种子可重现。
note.en: Full text confirms DSLE-5 is a five-boss subset, separate from the 22-boss extension. Identical saves and actions can diverge because game-internal randomness is unseeded; deterministic replay is not guaranteed.

note.zh: 正文与附录A/C补85维观察、延迟、五种子训练和最佳回应评测；将可利用性明确为近似下界。
note.en: Main text and appendices A/C establish 85-dimensional observations, delay, five-seed training and best-response evaluation; exploitability is explicitly an approximate lower bound.

note.zh: 确认具体游戏为 Super Mario Land，接入连续视觉控制和明确训练/测试划分的进度协议。
note.en: Confirmed Super Mario Land and added continuous visual control with explicit training/test progress evaluation.

note.zh: 全文Task Design与Implementation Details确认114任务、360步、四视角和5次试验；明确测试时同任务配置优化，避免误标跨游戏泛化。
note.en: Task Design and Implementation Details confirm 114 tasks, 360-step budgets, four views and five trials; adaptation is within the same task, not cross-game generalization.

note.zh: 核验实时闭环评测、存活帧指标及每种子尝试次数；不将模型预测误差计作游戏能力任务。
note.en: Verified live control, survival-frame metrics and attempts per seed; world-model prediction error is not counted as a gameplay task.

note.zh: 研究从视频预测键盘动作的逆动力学模型；作为方法研究保留，不将模型结构或方法收益直接记作独立基准覆盖。
note.en: Studies inverse-dynamics prediction of key presses from video; retained as method research, without turning architecture or method improvements into independent benchmark coverage.

note.zh: 全文5.3–5.4补50/10/5划分、冻结骨干、5万适应预算和不同归一化参照；能力限显式迁移评测。 本轮归属复核：附录B表1明确50个ID、10个Near-OOD、5个Far-OOD评测对象；这是表征冻结后的适配协议，游戏名称相同也须保留其分布角色。
note.en: Sections 5.3–5.4 establish 50/10/5 splits, frozen backbones, 50K adaptation budgets and different normalization references; capability is limited to explicit transfer evaluation. Routing review: Appendix B Table 1 identifies 50 ID, 10 near-OOD and 5 far-OOD evaluation targets; this is frozen-representation adaptation and split roles must be preserved.

note.en: Author PDF and rendered Figure 4 establish eight actual PPO gameplay evaluations. Detection F1/IoU and the wider support list are excluded from gameplay coverage.

note.zh: AAAI全文游戏分数表注确认500随机局、108K帧和采样设置；将静态注视/动作预测与真正在线游玩指标分离。 本轮归属复核：按图8的20款真实在线游戏分数关联，不将仅动作预测或注视数据当作在线评测。
note.en: The AAAI full-text score-table note specifies 500 random-seed episodes, 108K frames and sampling settings; static gaze/action prediction is separated from actual online gameplay. Routing review: Route the twenty games with actual online scores in Figure 8, separately from gaze/action prediction data.

note.zh: 全文3.3、4.3与表3核验46款而非ALE全部57款，9/37策略选择划分和最佳数据策略归一化；只登记Atari部分。 本轮归属复核：依据官方配置的实际数组关联46款：9款在线选参、37款离线选择评测。配置中的旧注释写45/36，与数组数量不符，因此以数组和论文为准。
note.en: Sections 3.3/4.3 and table 3 verify 46 games rather than all 57 ALE titles, the 9/37 selection split and best-data-policy normalization; Atari only. Routing review: Route forty-six explicit configuration entries: nine tuning and thirty-seven evaluation games. Stale 45/36 comments disagree with the executable lists and paper.

note.zh: 从全文补入人类模型队友的实际 5v5 协作协议；方法论文也可提供可限定的研究任务。
note.en: Added the actual 5v5 human-model cooperation protocol; the method paper supplies a bounded research task.

note.en: Author PDF establishes Honor of Kings rather than a placeholder collection and resolves observations, actions, win rates and participant preferences.

note.en: Author full text resolves cooperative dragon combat with level, skill, equipment and team-composition controls; this is not full 5v5 MOBA play.

note.zh: 全文III明确MM-SA-Bench统一多选题，另一部分为玩家特质归因与策略预测；测试战场截图/行为信息的理解，不让代理在MiaoSuan中下达闭环指令。保留问答与推理研究，移出游玩覆盖。
note.en: Section III uses multiple-choice situational-awareness questions; the other component tests trait attribution and strategy prediction. These reason over screenshots/behavior rather than issue closed-loop MiaoSuan commands; excluded from gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 论文协议和指标已核验；未运行复现。
note.en: Paper protocols and metrics verified; not reproduced.

note.zh: 全文5–6确认貂蝉1v1、固定购买/升级以及跨BT英雄98场；纠正MOBA不自动意味着多智能体队内协作。
note.en: Sections 5–6 establish Diaochan1v1, fixed purchase/upgrade orders and 98 matches across BT heroes; MOBA genre does not automatically imply team coordination.

note.zh: 作者 PDF 补齐全局 RTS 对局协议；明确本论文使用单地图、完全可观测设置，不能外推地图泛化或部分可观测记忆。
note.en: Author PDF resolves full RTS play on a single map under full observability; no map-generalization or partial-observation memory claim is added.

note.zh: 已核验任务协议和指标；未复现。
note.en: Task protocols and metrics verified; not reproduced.

note.zh: 全文3.2与4.3–4.5补门前三多攻击者协议、300步/5M训练/3种子和HELIOS接管范围；只登记进球评测。
note.en: Sections3.2 and4.3–4.5 establish three multi-attacker scenarios, 300-step/5M-training/three-seed controls and HELIOS takeover boundaries; only goal evaluation is registered.

note.zh: 作者全文确认是现实体育转播视频理解/生成与工具辅助分析。即使 T9 使用 Agent 工具，其输出仍是分析回答，不是游戏动作，不进入游玩能力覆盖图。
note.en: Full text confirms real-world sports video understanding/generation and tool-assisted analysis. T9 agents answer analysis questions rather than control gameplay, so no play-capability unit is added.

note.zh: 全文5.2与附录F明确14冻结对手、每检查点1312局、端口/角色条件及零延迟同步；剔除将控制器预测NLL当胜率的混淆，并注明对手选择泄漏边界。
note.en: Section5.2 and appendixF specify14 frozen opponents,1312 games/checkpoint, port/character conditions and zero-delay synchronization; controller NLL is separate from wins and opponent-selection overlap is disclosed.

note.zh: 附录C.10补Atari改造：128维RAM、连续到离散动作与1000步回合；在线游戏与机器人泛化严格分开，当前子范围仅Ms. Pac-Man/Space Invaders。
note.en: AppendixC.10 specifies Atari adaptations:128-dimensional RAM, continuous-to-discrete actions and1000-step episodes. Game scope is Ms. Pac-Man/Space Invaders, excluding robot-transfer results.

note.zh: 附录D.5核验初始化、40维观察和800步，纠正成功率实际为四项指标平均；只登记Easy传扣，不将全部任务概括为同一指标。
note.en: AppendixD.5 verifies initialization,40-dimensional observations and800 steps; the success metric is a four-indicator average. Only Easy set-and-spike is registered.

note.zh: 正文任务规范与4.3–4.4补六学院场景、19动作、门将托管和丢球终止；明确不把全场11v11设置混入学院分数。
note.en: Task specifications and4.3–4.4 establish six academy scenarios,19 actions, automated goalkeeper and possession-loss termination; full-match11v11 is kept separate.

note.zh: LM Fight Arena 在《真人快打 II》中比较多模态模型；同角色对战不代表全格斗游戏覆盖。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: LM Fight Arena compares multimodal models in Mortal Kombat II with matched fighters; this is not coverage of all fighting games. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 全文3.3–3.4与5.2补目标队位移和运费+赏金奖励，保留既有摄像机单元；目标队与摄像机指标分开，补3次运行及观察/通信对照。
note.en: Sections3.3–3.4/5.2 add target displacement and freight+bounty reward, preserving the camera unit. Target and camera metrics are separate, with three-run observation/communication comparisons.

note.zh: 将实际 CWM-MCTS 对局与静态代码/转移质量评测分开；接入井字棋和四子棋的胜和负协议。
note.en: Separated actual CWM-MCTS matches from static code/transition tests; added Tic-Tac-Toe and Connect Four game outcomes.

note.zh: 使用作者公开全文确认原目录标题的对应工作及两种 Hanabi 变体；标准 Hanabi 节点仅保留父关联，任务挂到精确变体。
note.en: The author full text confirms the corresponding work and two Hanabi variants; standard Hanabi remains a parent link while tasks target exact variants.

note.zh: 接入论文表 4–5 的真实对局，明确固定对手与专项模型互战的不同；未把数学推理测试计入。
note.en: Added actual matches in Tables 4–5, distinguishing fixed-opponent and specialist matchups; mathematical reasoning tests are excluded.

note.zh: 通过正确的作者全文补入标准 Chess 子游戏及平衡执色比赛协议。
note.en: The correct author full text supports the standard Chess child and color-balanced match protocol.

note.zh: 明确 HUNL 游戏归属与实际筹码收益指标，并将对手名纠正为 OpenStack（DeepStack 复现）。
note.en: Confirmed HUNL attribution and chip-return metrics, correcting the opponent to OpenStack, a DeepStack reimplementation.

note.zh: 确认完整 Stratego 对局及实际人类排位指标；明确历史对手和时间边界。
note.en: Confirmed complete Stratego games and actual ranked-human metrics, with historical opponent/time limits.

note.zh: 补齐实际出牌接口、分座位对战和 WP/ADP 指标；将叫牌实验排除于本任务范围。
note.en: Added actual play interface, role-conditioned matches and WP/ADP, excluding the separate bidding experiment.

note.zh: BotzoneBench 明确使用八个游戏和固定等级机器人锚点，需按角色与随机种子控制对战。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: BotzoneBench uses eight games and graded fixed-bot anchors, controlling seats and random seeds. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 从合法走子序列重建每步完整棋盘状态。 指标：ExactState全部75项正确；标签准确率与轨迹精确性。 无选招或对手对战；不能解读为国际象棋棋力。 保留诊断文献，不计入交互游玩能力覆盖。
note.en: Reconstruct the complete board state from legal move sequences. Metrics: ExactState requires all 75 labels; label accuracy and trajectory exactness. No move selection or opponents; not chess playing strength. Retained as diagnostic literature, excluded from interactive gameplay coverage.

note.zh: DungeonBench 是 D&D 2014 风格规则模拟器，分单场 Encounter 与资源跨场持续的 Day 轨道。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: DungeonBench is a D&D-2014-style simulator with single Encounter and persistent-resource Day tracks. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 全文6区分建议完整预算与实际2种子×30局参考实验，避免将建议预算当已跑结果；补3077观察/478掩码动作和配对迁移指标。
note.en: Section6 distinguishes the prescribed full budget from actual two-seed×30-episode reference experiments; adds3077 observations/478 masked actions and paired transfer metrics.

note.zh: OpenGuanDan 支持四人合作竞争、多轮比赛及人机评测；全局胜负与搭档适应应区别。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: OpenGuanDan supports four-player team competition, multi-round matches, and human evaluation; winning and partner adaptation are distinct. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: PTCG-Bench 应区分固定策略牌局与跨局自我改进，评分受牌组和 harness 影响。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: PTCG-Bench separates fixed-policy matches from longitudinal self-improvement; deck and harness choices affect scores. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 全文3–4明确仅六游戏×8语言实测，以及每方向400局、交换角色和胜负差公式；不把翻译库总规模扩大成已评测覆盖。
note.en: Sections3–4 limit experiments to six games×eight languages,400 games per direction, role reversal and win-loss margins; translation-library size is not evaluated coverage.

note.zh: 全文3核验每游戏200局组成及确定化MCTS搜索预算；保留游戏内分数分布，明确非统一胜率排行榜。 本轮归属复核：关联全部21款已实验CardStock实现；使用明确的Valet变体节点，保留单局制、无传牌Hearts/Scarto、Block Rummy等规则差别。
note.en: Section3 verifies200-game composition per title and determinized-MCTS search budgets; metrics remain game-specific score distributions, not a universal win-rate leaderboard. Routing review: Route all twenty-one experimentally tested CardStock implementations as Valet variants, retaining single-deal, no-pass Hearts/Scarto and Block Rummy differences.

note.zh: 全文5.5及附录核验真实短对局：最多10个模型步、Stockfish18 depth20、3种子；1118静态谜题与交互短对局分开，不以题目准确率代表通盘实力。
note.en: Section5.5 and appendices verify short gameplay: ten model moves,Stockfish18 depth20 and three seeds. The1118 static puzzles are distinct from interactive rollouts and full-game strength.

note.zh: 全文3.1–3.3与算法1/2确认静态最终线索与动态历史日志回放；动态线索按原人类对局更新并注入人类错误猜测，不由模型与真人实时协商产生。指标为found rate/猜测数，暂不计闭环社会协作覆盖。
note.en: Sections3.1–3.3 and algorithms1/2 use final clues or replayed human logs. Dynamic clues follow the original game and inject human wrong guesses rather than live model-human negotiation. Found rate/guess count are retained, without closed-loop social coverage.

note.zh: 全文4.1与附录E补SCII五类宏动作、10局/场景和RPM等公式，并新增既有StarCraft II游戏关联；本次未将六环境五维标签整体摊到每个子游戏。
note.en: Section4.1 and appendixE specify SCII macro actions, ten matches/scenario and RPM-related formulas, with an existing StarCraft II association; suite-wide labels are not spread across all six games.

note.zh: LudoBench 的主要评测是 480 个单步局面，而非完整多智能体长局。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: The main LudoBench evaluation is 480 single-decision spots, not complete long multi-agent games. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 全文实验证据主要为单位参数平衡：随机/半随机队伍的大规模模拟、成对胜负矩阵和不同平衡损失比较；55K games/s是引擎吞吐。未定位固定学习代理与独立评测任务的完整协议，保留环境/设计研究，不新增能力任务。
note.en: Full-text experiments primarily evaluate unit-parameter balancing through random/semi-random teams, win-loss matrices and balancing losses;55K games/s is throughput. A complete fixed learning-agent evaluation protocol was not located, so no capability unit is added.

note.zh: 全文5.1与附录A.3明确200步/5重试、换色、Glicko及观察模式；保留完整对局单元，静态重建和谜题不并入。
note.en: Section5.1 and appendixA.3 establish200 moves/five retries, color reversal,Glicko and observation modes; full matches are separate from static reconstruction/puzzles.

note.zh: 全文3与3.1核验10代理×20轮×5重复及猜均值原始分公式；将该有限协议与公共品/海盗等游戏分开，不把均衡分数解释为社会能力总分。
note.en: Sections3/3.1 verify ten agents×20 rounds×five repeats and the guessing-game score formula; other games remain separate and equilibrium score is not a general social-capability score.

note.zh: 全文4–5及实验图表评估Nash/Stackelberg求解器：效用、运行时间、策略支持集与收敛，比较真实目标和随机化矩阵/日程。属于安全博弈求解实例，并非玩家逐回合观测行动的游戏代理协议，保留研究条目但不计游玩图。
note.en: Sections4–5 evaluate Nash/Stackelberg solvers through utility,runtime,support size and convergence on real versus randomized target/matrix/schedule instances. These are security-game solver problems, not turn-by-turn game-agent protocols; retained outside gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 补齐八种明确游戏映射，按胜率、回合胜率、麻将排名和 RLCard 原生收益分为四个协议单位。
note.en: Added all eight explicit game mappings and four protocol units separating win rate, round win rate, Mahjong placement and native RLCard rewards.

note.zh: 正文§2与§4明确文本状态、合法动作和动作解析；§5报告七游戏的运行结果和推理分布。新增井字棋交互任务，未把推理关键词分类当作独立认知测量。 本轮归属复核：只关联该单位明确的OpenSpiel井字棋对局，不扩展到框架注册的其他游戏。
note.en: Sections 2/4 specify textual states, legal actions and parsing; Section 5 reports seven-game runs and rationale distributions. Add tic-tac-toe gameplay without treating rationale keywords as independent cognitive measurements. Routing review: Only the unit’s explicit OpenSpiel Tic-Tac-Toe matches are routed; other registered games are excluded.

note.zh: 正文§3明确九游戏、同等可见信息及动作接口；评级采用按游戏逆频率重采样的Bradley–Terry，并做10000次bootstrap。仅建立明确的跨游戏比赛协议，不把其六项游戏属性等同六项能力实测。 本轮归属复核：关联9款实际实现；共同评分协议保留无统一能力标签，另以论文明确子集建立策略、合作及隐藏角色推理单位。
note.en: Section 3 specifies nine games, equal visible information and action interfaces; ratings use game-inverse-frequency resampling and 10000 Bradley–Terry bootstraps. Game properties are not isolated capability measurements. Routing review: Route nine actual implementations; the common score protocol retains no uniform capability label, with source-defined subsets represented separately.

note.zh: 正文§2–3明确NRA相对优势指标、MCTS 1000次模拟对手和囚徒困境Tit-for-Tat参照。新增重复囚徒困境任务；其他九游戏仍不继承该协议。 本轮归属复核：明确为可见历史动作的重复囚徒困境，不合并为单次囚徒困境。
note.en: Sections 2–3 define NRA, MCTS with 1000 simulations and Tit-for-Tat for repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma. Add that task without applying its protocol to the other games. Routing review: This is the history-dependent iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma, not the one-shot game.

note.zh: §2核验黑方30局随机对手筛查及每引擎等级30局；Unicode棋盘/UCI工具，逐ply无历史，100回合上限、10次对话与每次3次合法性尝试。
note.en: Section 2 verifies 30 black-side games against random and 30 per engine level; Unicode board/UCI tools, no ply history, 100-move cap, ten conversation turns and three validity attempts per turn.

note.zh: PokerBench 是 11,000 个专家标注牌局决策，非完整扑克对战，也非直接测量欺骗。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: PokerBench contains 11,000 expert-labeled decisions, not full poker matches or a direct deception test. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: §2.1–2.5确认主要输出是均衡/策略组合答案，复杂形式要求全部子题正确；144类型及其故事改写是解题实例，不是持续互动游戏。按请求不生成游玩任务。
note.en: Sections 2.1–2.5 evaluate equilibrium/strategy-combination answers, including all-correct composite questions. The 144 classes and story variants are reasoning items rather than ongoing gameplay; no gameplay unit is added.

note.zh: 平台论文有真实棋类对局而不只有吞吐量，已接入五个明确定义的棋盘变体及 Elo 协议。
note.en: The platform paper contains real board-game evaluations beyond throughput; added five explicitly defined variants and their Elo protocol.

detail.zh: 原文 §6 的指标为完整随机 playout/秒，未给候选 Agent 的胜率、回报或解题成功率。
detail.en: Section 6 measures complete random playouts/second, not candidate-agent win rate, return or solving success.

detail.zh: 尚缺与棋力指标配套的具体 Agent、对手、对局数量及座位控制；已有引擎动作 API 不足以替代。
detail.en: A concrete candidate/opponent matchup, game count and seat control linked to playing-strength metrics remains missing; engine action APIs do not supply it.

note.zh: 阅读全文后确认现有量化实验是引擎吞吐量比较。虽有规则、合法动作与完整随机对局，本轮未找到对应 Agent 表现评测，不将每秒 playout 数画成能力覆盖。
note.en: Full text confirms that its quantitative experiment compares engine throughput. Rules, legal actions and complete random playouts exist, but no corresponding agent-performance evaluation was found; playouts/second are not capability coverage.

note.zh: 附录 A 明确了 21 组公共品设置：3 人、5 轮、7 个倍增系数及轮换测试席位；新增该任务，保留原任务。公共品胜率是个人最终分最高的比例，不能等同团队福利。
note.en: Appendix A specifies 21 public-goods settings: three players, five rounds, seven multipliers and rotated test seats. Individual winning rate is distinct from communal welfare.

note.zh: 从 §5 的实际比赛补入语言谈判与军令协议，并按显式 18/34 中心阈值处理正文笔误。
note.en: Added Section 5 match protocols for negotiation and military orders, resolving prose errors using the explicit 18/34-center threshold.

note.zh: 补入精确 ONUW 子游戏；限定为五人固定夜间条件下的讨论—投票闭环，而非多夜狼人杀。
note.en: Added the precise ONUW child, scoped to five-player discussion/voting after fixed night events, not multi-night Werewolf.

detail.zh: Balance Beam 与 Overcooked 的独立动作/指标绑定仍需拆分。
detail.en: Separate action/metric bindings remain for Balance Beam and Overcooked.

note.zh: Blind Bandits 的左右动作、私有历史和合作约定奖励已核实并纳入；Balance Beam 与人类 Overcooked 试验仍未在本次拆成独立协议。
note.en: Verified and integrated Blind Bandits actions, private histories and convention rewards; Balance Beam and human Overcooked studies are not separate protocols in this pass.

note.zh: Generative Agents 是 Smallville 社交模拟代理架构，访谈可信度与涌现行为不是本网站的游戏胜率。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: Generative Agents is a Smallville simulation architecture; believability interviews and emergent behavior are not gameplay win scores. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: 有交流 Diplomacy 的私聊、同时指令和补给中心计分已纳入；范围限定于原论文人类 blitz 联赛。
note.en: Integrated private dialogue, simultaneous orders and supply-centre scoring in full-press Diplomacy, limited to the paper’s human blitz league.

detail.zh: 真实人类实验条件尚未另建协议。
detail.en: Human-participant conditions are not separately encoded.

note.zh: 已纳入五布局上的未见伙伴交付评测；将协作和伙伴泛化区分，不混入真实人类试验。
note.en: Integrated held-out-partner delivery evaluation on five layouts, separating coordination and partner transfer from the human study.

note.zh: 算法1完整给出七人、五轮淘汰及终局陪审投票，论文有999局与Plackett–Luce不确定性评级。公开包只含日志/分析，运行基础设施未发布；任务协议已核验，复现实用性仍有限。 本轮归属复核：该单位就是AgentIsland自定义淘汰与陪审投票游戏，按完整具名环境登记，不当作游戏合集。
note.en: Algorithm 1 specifies seven players, five eliminations and a finalist jury vote; 999 games support Plackett–Luce skill estimates. Released artifacts contain logs/analysis, not the runner; the protocol is verified but execution availability is limited. Routing review: The unit is AgentIsland’s bespoke elimination and jury-voting game, recorded as one named environment rather than a collection.

note.zh: 对97个场景的408条二元陈述判断真伪。 指标：四类能力准确率、macro-F1及宏平均。 静态问答，不测完整比赛、在线协作或运动控制。 保留诊断文献，不计入交互游玩能力覆盖。
note.en: Judge 408 binary statements across 97 scenarios. Metrics: Per-ability accuracy, macro-F1, and macro-average. Static QA, not complete games, online coordination, or motor control. Retained as diagnostic literature, excluded from interactive gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 核验§2–5：离散状态平稳均值场博弈求解，目标为策略与群体分布的不动点；MF-Garnets生成随机博弈并比较可利用度/收敛。属于求解器评测，不是电子游戏Agent交互成绩。
note.en: Sections 2–5 study fixed points of policy and population distribution in stationary discrete MFGs. MF-Garnets generates solver tests of exploitability/convergence, not videogame-agent gameplay.

note.zh: GPTNT 的拆弹交互与 ManualVQA 是不同轨道；实时与同步模式必须分开比较。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: GPTNT separates bomb-defusal interaction from ManualVQA, and real-time versus synchronous modes require separate comparisons. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 本轮按统一标准接入有明确观测、动作与指标的限定任务；仍缺的配置写入 limits。文献协议已核验、未复现，不表示 Arena 可运行。
note.en: This pass includes a bounded task with explicit observations, actions and metrics; remaining configuration gaps are recorded in limits. Literature reviewed, not reproduced and not an Arena runnable claim.

note.zh: 全文明确四游戏的错误处理并不一致；新增 Colonel Blotto 的隐藏资源分配任务，胜率必须与格式/非法分配失败率一起报告。 本轮归属复核：仅关联明确的Colonel Blotto资源分配任务，不扩展到MindGames其他博弈。
note.en: The full paper specifies different error handling across its four games; added hidden resource allocation in Colonel Blotto, with wins interpreted alongside invalid-action failures. Routing review: Route only the explicit Colonel Blotto resource-allocation task, not other MindGames games.

note.zh: 全文给出 5 人 Spyfall 的角色、10 轮调度、严格 JSON 与胜负规则；新增实际交互任务。文化知识与语言熟练度仍影响结果，不把其分数当纯社会推理测量。
note.en: The full paper specifies five-player Spyfall, a ten-turn schedule, strict JSON and terminal rules. Cultural knowledge and language proficiency remain confounds.

note.zh: 补充五人 Secret Hitler 的角色结构、政府提名/投票/政策阶段与角色推断指标。核验范围为论文五人设置，非全部人数规则。
note.en: Added the five-player role structure, government nomination/voting/policy phases and role-inference metrics; scope excludes other player counts.

note.zh: 本轮按统一标准接入有明确观测、动作与指标的限定任务；仍缺的配置写入 limits。文献协议已核验、未复现，不表示 Arena 可运行。
note.en: This pass includes a bounded task with explicit observations, actions and metrics; remaining configuration gaps are recorded in limits. Literature reviewed, not reproduced and not an Arena runnable claim.

note.zh: 分析已记录Hanabi出牌，比较字面信息下失败概率与实际失败。 指标：Convention Gap＝字面预测失败率−实际失败率。 非零值不是约定内容量或因果效应，也不是记忆测验。 保留诊断文献，不计入交互游玩能力覆盖。
note.en: Analyze logged Hanabi plays, comparing literal-information failure probability to observed failures. Metrics: Convention Gap = literal predicted failure minus observed failure. Nonzero gaps are neither convention information quantity nor causal effect or memory score. Retained as diagnostic literature, excluded from interactive gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 明确区分原始决策与被通信通道翻转后的执行决策，新增 Stag Hunt 腐化通道实验。该实验的机械翻转效应不解释为模型自身欺骗。
note.en: Distinguished original decisions from channel-flipped executed decisions and added the corrupted-channel Stag Hunt experiment; mechanical flips are not agent deception.

note.zh: 正文 §2 和附录 B 完整区分 Chess/Poker/Werewolf 的输入、非法动作处理和主指标；补充三个独立协议，不产生跨游戏统一总分。
note.en: Section 2 and Appendix B distinguish Chess/Poker/Werewolf inputs, invalid-action handling and primary metrics. Added three independent protocols without inventing a cross-game total score.

note.zh: 附录明确两个实际交互协议，分别建立9人狼人杀与7人文字版 Among Us 节点；胜率对应隐藏身份推断，不代表图形版操作。
note.en: The appendix specifies two interactive protocols, now separated into nine-player Werewolf and seven-player text-adapted Among Us; win rates concern hidden-role play, not graphical control.

note.zh: 对1,224条狼人杀指控评估旁观村民的信念变化。 指标：按真实阵营与指控者信任分层的信念/变化；均值95%区间。 主观量表诊断，不是整局胜率；无法单靠信念幅度判断合理性。 保留诊断文献，不计入交互游玩能力覆盖。
note.en: Evaluate village observers’ belief changes for 1,224 Werewolf accusations. Metrics: Beliefs/shifts stratified by true role and accuser trust, with 95% mean intervals. Subjective-scale diagnostic, not win rate; shift size alone is not rationality. Retained as diagnostic literature, excluded from interactive gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 正文 §2 明确 5 船员 + 2 内鬼、50 步时限和会议三轮讨论；新增这一文字沙盒的互动协议。2054 局的角色战绩与欺骗探针检测指标分开，不把探针准确率当游玩能力。
note.en: Section 2 specifies five crewmates, two impostors, a fifty-step limit and three discussion rounds per meeting. Added this text-sandbox protocol; gameplay outcomes over 2,054 games remain separate from deception-probe detection.

note.zh: 附录与指标章节明确追捕/逃脱的成功率和回合数；原合并单位保留 ID 并细分为追捕，新增发电机逃脱单位，避免重复计数。198 道 CoordinationQA 仍不计交互能力。
note.en: The appendix specifies capture/escape success and turns. The original combined ID is retained for capture and escape is separated to avoid double counting; the 198 CoordinationQA questions remain outside interactive coverage.

note.zh: 正文明确 Nim 合法动作与胜负，评分采用初始 1000、K=32 的 Elo；新增 Nim 回合任务。尚未核实每个游戏的完整配置与配对样本量，保留部分核验。
note.en: The main text specifies legal Nim moves and outcomes, with Elo initialized at 1000 and K=32. Per-game configurations and pairing sample sizes remain incompletely verified.

note.zh: 附录 A.9 核实 Minecraft 的 100 个结构、11 个高层工具及方块类型/坐标/方向命中率；新增建造任务。LLM 评分的沟通/规划分与环境命中率分开呈现。
note.en: Appendix A.9 verifies 100 structures, eleven high-level tools and block type/location/orientation hit rate; judge-based communication/planning scores are distinct from environment accuracy.

note.zh: 正文 §4 与 §5 给出 Contract 的结盟阶段及共享收益物理阶段；补充该任务而非给所有平台小游戏套同一标签。
note.en: Sections 4–5 define Contract’s group-formation phase and reward-sharing physical phase; added this task without transferring labels to all platform games.

note.zh: 附录 B 明确了文字版 Among Us 的动作和观测，正文给出 4 船员 + 1 内鬼、每船员三类任务、四种控制组合各 20 次实验。新增任务，角色胜率与 GPT-4 标注的发言类型分别记录。
note.en: Appendix B specifies the text-based Among Us action/observation interface; experiments use four crewmates and one impostor, three task types per crewmate and twenty runs per control condition.

note.zh: AvalonBench 的隐藏角色、讨论、提案和投票形成社会推理任务，角色胜率应分别报告。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: AvalonBench combines hidden roles, discussion, proposals, and voting; role-specific win rates should remain separate. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 全文将单队合作和双队对抗分开：各模型/版本组合固定种子 0–99 共 100 次。补充双队任务，不把单队步数与双队胜率混合。
note.en: The full paper separates single-team cooperation from two-team competition, with 100 trials using seeds 0–99 per combination. Added the two-team protocol without mixing its wins with single-team turn scores.

note.zh: 附录 A.7 核实 LLMArena 使用双人、双色、每人两张手牌的缩小 Hanabi，初始 3 个信息 token。新增这一变体，避免误当标准五色设置。 本轮归属复核：附录A.7明确两人、两色、每手两张牌与三个信息令牌，单列缩小版，不能与标准Hanabi成绩混算；原提示的生命令牌描述不一致。
note.en: Appendix A.7 verifies a reduced two-player, two-color Hanabi with two cards per hand and three initial information tokens; this is not the standard five-color configuration. Routing review: Appendix A.7 specifies two players, two colors, two-card hands and three information tokens. Keep this small variant separate; the prompt is internally inconsistent about life tokens.

note.zh: Balderdash 分别检验真假定义混淆和正确识别，创造性语言并非现有九维中的独立标签。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: Balderdash separately measures deceptive definitions and correct identification; linguistic creativity is not a separate current dimension. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: Welfare Diplomacy 改写奖励为福利，是非零和规则变体，不应与原版 Diplomacy 胜率混合。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: Welfare Diplomacy changes rewards to welfare, a general-sum variant whose scores should not mix with standard Diplomacy wins. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

detail.zh: PushBox和其他Unity游戏未补齐逐任务动作接口。
detail.en: Per-task action bindings remain for PushBox and other Unity games.

note.zh: Crossroads 已确认移动/转向、团队全员到达奖励及种群排名；只将该竞赛协议纳入，不复制到平台其余游戏。
note.en: Crossroads has verified move/turn actions, team-arrival rewards and population rankings; only that race protocol is integrated.

note.zh: 正文 §3–5 核实 500 步、24 阶段主线的游戏推进协议，明确主线奖励优先、辅助奖励用于破同分。知识/记忆选择题为旁路诊断，不复制成独立操控能力。 本轮归属复核：官方文档明确Remnant用于实验1；只关联24阶段主线单位，不扩展到实验2的Mark。
note.en: Sections 3–5 verify a 500-step game with a 24-stage main quest, ranked first by main-quest reward then supplementary reward. Knowledge/memory QA is auxiliary diagnostics, not separate control capability. Routing review: Official documentation identifies Remnant as Experiment 1; the twenty-four-stage quest unit does not extend to Experiment 2’s Mark.

note.zh: ARC-AGI-3 让智能体探索无明示目标的新环境，主分数按人类动作效率归一化。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。 本轮归属复核：该单位是私有新环境的整体动作效率评测；公共示例环境不是官方私有榜单的替代游戏名单。
note.en: ARC-AGI-3 requires exploration of novel environments without explicit goals and scores relative to human action efficiency. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions. Routing review: This unit measures action efficiency on private novel environments; public examples do not substitute for the private leaderboard set.

note.zh: 附录 C 给出干预变量、工具调用及终局 1000 架机队验证；新增天线陷阱的交互实验设计任务。该任务是抽象仿真，不是无人机实时操控。 本轮归属复核：只关联附录C.2.1的Antenna Trap任务族；部署区域、天气及随机种子不继承该单位。
note.en: Appendix C specifies interventions, tools and final validation on 1,000 drones. Added interactive experiment design for Antenna Trap; this is abstract simulation, not real-time piloting. Routing review: Route only the Antenna Trap family in Appendix C.2.1; deployment-zone and weather families do not inherit this unit.

note.zh: 本轮按统一标准接入有明确观测、动作与指标的限定任务；仍缺的配置写入 limits。文献协议已核验、未复现，不表示 Arena 可运行。
note.en: This pass includes a bounded task with explicit observations, actions and metrics; remaining configuration gaps are recorded in limits. Literature reviewed, not reproduced and not an Arena runnable claim.

note.zh: DiG-bench 使用未知字符串变换规则与目标，70 游戏仅 21 公开；公开集和私有集分数需分开。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。 本轮归属复核：保留70个隐藏规则字符串游戏的共同发现协议；21个公开游戏不代表其余私有游戏，暂不向示例逐项铺设能力。
note.en: DiG-bench uses unknown string transformation rules and goals; 21 of 70 games are public, requiring split-specific reporting. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions. Routing review: Retain the shared discovery protocol over seventy string games; twenty-one public games do not represent the private remainder.

note.zh: NCP-Bench 评估叙事者保持承诺与事实一致性，不是玩家完成游戏任务的能力。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: NCP-Bench evaluates narrator commitment/fact consistency, not player task-completion ability. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: RNG-Bench 的配对与迷宫任务区分回忆失败与行动选择失败，适合作为记忆诊断。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。 本轮归属复核：关联§3.3明确的Matching Pairs (RNG-Bench)环境；地图大小、图案和观测模态是控制变量，不另算游戏。 关联§3.3明确的3D Maze (RNG-Bench)环境；地图大小、图案和观测模态是控制变量，不另算游戏。
note.en: RNG-Bench separates forgetting from action-selection errors in Matching Pairs and 3D Maze, supporting memory diagnostics. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions. Routing review: Route the explicit Matching Pairs (RNG-Bench) environment in Section 3.3; sizes, patterns and observation modalities are controls, not separate games. Route the explicit 3D Maze (RNG-Bench) environment in Section 3.3; sizes, patterns and observation modalities are controls, not separate games.

note.zh: Rushes 是人类互动叙事选择预测数据，评价个体偏好，不是游戏 Agent 的任务完成 benchmark。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: Rushes predicts human interactive-narrative choices and personalized preferences, not agent task completion. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: ChronoPlay 是游戏知识 RAG 问答与内容时效 benchmark，不属于游戏控制能力覆盖。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: ChronoPlay benchmarks game-domain RAG and information freshness, not gameplay control capabilities. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: 本轮按统一标准接入有明确观测、动作与指标的限定任务；仍缺的配置写入 limits。文献协议已核验、未复现，不表示 Arena 可运行。
note.en: This pass includes a bounded task with explicit observations, actions and metrics; remaining configuration gaps are recorded in limits. Literature reviewed, not reproduced and not an Arena runnable claim.

detail.zh: 其余游戏的能力需按各自目标另外判定。
detail.en: Other games require goal-specific capability review.

note.zh: 保留34款共同评测协议，新增仅限 Game Cafe Escape 的依赖规划视图；未向其余33款传播规划标签。
note.en: Preserved the 34-game protocol and added a Game Cafe Escape dependency-planning view; no planning label is propagated to the other games.

detail.zh: 完整剧本名称及逐剧本角色/轮次清单未核实。
detail.en: Complete script names and per-script roles/rounds remain unverified.

detail.zh: 公开README所列启动代码尚未在公开目录中核实。
detail.en: The launcher named by the public README was not verified in the public tree.

note.zh: 已核实50剧本竞技场的角色讨论、推理、最终投票与胜率，按互动社会推理纳入；感知QA和链式问答仍在游玩覆盖之外。
note.en: Verified the fifty-script arena’s role discussion, reasoning, voting and win rate, integrating interactive social inference while excluding perception/chain QA.

note.zh: 正文与任务说明明确 Taboo 的三次猜词、禁词验证和 100/n 速度分；新增双人协议，未向其余 clembench 游戏复制标签。 本轮归属复核：关联clembench的禁词描述/猜词对话变体，不把商业Taboo全部规则或其他对话游戏纳入。
note.en: The task description specifies three guesses, taboo-word validation and 100/n speed scoring. The added protocol is limited to this two-player game. Routing review: Route clembench’s constrained clue-and-guess dialogue variant, not all commercial Taboo rules or other dialogue games.

detail.zh: 缺少某个具体游戏/成就的可核对任务机制及其与11轴的对应依据；已有总奖励和伦理指标不能替代。
detail.en: A concrete game/achievement mechanism and traceable mapping to an eleven-axis construct are still needed; aggregate rewards and ethics metrics are insufficient.

note.zh: 保留30款测试游戏的叙事选择、成就与伤害协议。当前论文的伦理伤害、权力指标和当前场景提示，不足以将某个具体游戏映射到11条能力轴；不把伦理评价当社会推理。
note.en: Preserved narrative choice, achievement and harm evaluation for thirty test games. Ethical-harm/power metrics and current-scene prompts do not establish a specific game’s eleven-axis capability; ethics is not treated as social inference.

note.zh: ScienceWorld 的科学任务包含多步实验与状态变化；任务得分和未知环境泛化应分开。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: ScienceWorld includes multistep experiments and state changes; task score and held-out-environment generalization differ. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 全文 §4.3 与表 2 明确 embodied 结果平均三次评估；BUTLER 使用 Mask R-CNN/A*，Oracle 使用真实状态及直接传送，必须分开。保留已核验任务，不能把上层文本策略迁移描述为纯像素原生控制。
note.en: Section 4.3/Table 2 averages embodied results over three evaluations. BUTLER uses Mask R-CNN/A* while the Oracle uses true state and teleportation. These conditions must remain separate; text-policy transfer is not direct pixel-to-native control.

note.zh: JerichoWorld 是观测到知识图谱/有效动作的监督数据集，不是完整文字游戏通关 benchmark。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: JerichoWorld is supervised observation-to-graph/valid-action data, not a full text-game completion benchmark. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: 全文核实物品整理任务、IN/OUT 泛化拆分、100 训练回合、10 次重复和测试最多 50 步；补充可复核交互协议。
note.en: The full paper verifies object tidying, IN/OUT generalization splits, 100 training episodes, ten runs and a 50-step test limit.

detail.zh: 其余ROM未统一赋予探索或规划。
detail.en: Other ROMs are not uniformly tagged exploration or planning.

note.zh: 保留33个ROM的共同协议，并依据§7.2新增 Deephome 首访房间奖励视图，明确其探索得分仍与其他目标奖励混合。
note.en: Preserved the 33-ROM protocol and added Deephome’s first-room-visit view from Section 7.2, explicitly retaining mixed exploration/objective rewards.

note.zh: 四个TextWorldExpress实际交互任务分别纳入；算术与排序映射规则推理，地图任务映射空间推理，均保留工具辅助条件。TWC常识不强行套轴。
note.en: Integrated four TextWorldExpress tasks separately: arithmetic/sorting map to rule reasoning and MapReader to spatial reasoning, with tool assistance explicit; TWC commonsense is not force-mapped.

note.zh: LongPuzzleBench 按 16 个目标组织 114 关，重点为动作的未来可行性与持续目标完成，而非仅交互次数。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: LongPuzzleBench organizes 114 levels into 16 objectives, testing future feasibility and sustained completion rather than interaction length alone. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

detail.zh: GameWorld、AI GameStore 等其他VISTA试验未在本轮逐任务纳入；静态BabyVision排除。
detail.en: Other VISTA GameWorld/AI GameStore experiments are not individually integrated; static BabyVision is excluded.

note.zh: 核实25个公开ARC-AGI-3游戏的互动规则发现、动作接口和RHAE；只将明确共有的未知规则探索归类，不为各游戏复制其他能力标签。
note.en: Verified interactive rule discovery, action interface and RHAE on twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games; only the explicitly shared unknown-rule exploration mechanism is mapped.

note.zh: 核验隐藏规则路径任务及规则保留测试；不把规则记事本当成独立记忆能力证明。 本轮归属复核：主结果基于17个私有测试游戏，另有8个公开验证游戏；保留共同协议，不能用训练/验证示例替代私有测试成员。
note.en: Verified hidden-rule path tasks and held-out-rule evaluation; a rule notebook alone does not establish memory competence. Routing review: Main results concern seventeen private test games, with eight public validation games; training/validation examples cannot replace private test members.

note.zh: 核验六种游戏的E2E交互评分与对手实现；感知、问答和规则判断分轨处理，不作为额外操控任务计数。
note.en: Verified six E2E games and opponent implementations; perception, QA and rule-following tracks are not counted as extra control tasks.

note.zh: 核验 XLand-MiniGrid 上的上下文适应协议；不是所有规则都单独证明规划或记忆。
note.en: Verified in-context adaptation on XLand-MiniGrid; individual rules are not automatically planning or memory tests.

note.zh: 核验三个ASCII棋盘交互任务；Shapes与LCL属于符号识别/结构判断，不计入操控覆盖。Battleship采用论文简化表示，不套用商业隐藏信息规则。
note.en: Verified three ASCII board tasks; Shapes and LCL are symbolic recognition/structure tasks and do not count as gameplay control. Battleship follows the paper-specific representation.

note.zh: 已核验150张Word2World地图的顺序目标遍历协议、A*参照与GTB-Score；地图族和其成员任务不重复计数。
note.en: Verified sequential traversal of 150 Word2World maps with A* reference and GTB-Score; the collection and its task are not duplicated.

note.zh: 40 个任务的规则、输入、动作和评测协议已由论文与官方实现核验。能力标签按任务区分；静态约束推理不强行等同于规划，尺寸泛化仅标论文实际测试的三项。
note.en: Rules, observations, actions and evaluation protocol are verified for all 40 tasks. Static constraint reasoning is not automatically labelled planning; size generalization is assigned only to the three tested puzzles.

note.zh: 全文将上下文分布关系明确区分为插值、分布移位与外推；保留已核验 Mario 关卡实验范围。经典控制环境的摩擦/目标改变并不自动成为 Mario 的能力标签；完整平台仍不宣称逐环境核验。
note.en: The full text distinguishes interpolation, distribution shift and extrapolation through context distributions. Retain the verified Mario-level experiment; friction/goal interventions in classical control do not automatically label Mario or every platform environment.

note.zh: 核验三种有限记忆任务；后续 endless 版本不混入 2023 原协议。
note.en: Verified three finite memory tasks; later endless versions are not mixed with the original 2023 protocol.

note.zh: 正文 §4 明确每个 PPO checkpoint 分别评估 100 个人工关卡和 100 个随机关卡；已补入既有 EscapeRoom 的控制条件。该已界定的案例协议可核验，非所有 Griddly 游戏。
note.en: Section 4 evaluates each PPO checkpoint on 100 human-designed and 100 randomized levels. Added these controls to the bounded EscapeRoom case study; other Griddly games are excluded.

note.zh: 已核验三阶段送信任务、实体与动态泛化划分；成功率衡量按手册取信并交付，不能仅凭动态观察将全部任务计为记忆测试。
note.en: Verified three-stage delivery tasks and entity/dynamics splits; success requires obtaining and delivering the message using the manual.

note.zh: 核验SILG五个环境的符号交互协议；RTFM和Messenger论文结果仅第一课程阶段，NetHack为Score/Gold/Scout子任务。
note.en: Verified symbolic protocols in five environments; reported RTFM and Messenger results cover curriculum stage one, and NetHack uses Score/Gold/Scout subtasks.

note.zh: 官方实验目录明确每任务以 sweep.py 固定配置、analysis.py 定义评分。保留已核验 Memory Length/Deep Sea 两项，并强调需绑定相应 sweep 和评分；不把套件雷达图平均值当任意子任务能力。 本轮归属复核：仅关联bsuite明确的Memory Length诊断环境，难度长度/大小是参数扫描。 仅关联bsuite明确的Deep Sea诊断环境，难度长度/大小是参数扫描。
note.en: The official experiment directory assigns configurations to sweep.py and scoring to analysis.py. Retain the verified Memory Length/Deep Sea scope, tied to those files; suite radar averages do not label arbitrary subtasks. Routing review: Route only bsuite’s explicit Memory Length diagnostic environment; lengths/sizes are parameter sweeps. Route only bsuite’s explicit Deep Sea diagnostic environment; lengths/sizes are parameter sweeps.

note.zh: 多角色动作条件视频生成；评测动作绑定、身份一致性及画面质量，不是协作策略执行。
note.en: Multi-subject action-conditioned video generation evaluates action binding, identity consistency and visual quality, not cooperative policies.

note.zh: 编码 Agent 在固定算力内改进世界模型；指标为保留测试集动力学预测质量，不是游戏通关。
note.en: Coding agents improve a world model under fixed compute; held-out dynamics prediction is evaluated, not game completion.

note.zh: 从游戏视频移除 UI；评价去除质量、背景保留和下游生成质量，不计入游戏操控能力。
note.en: Removes gameplay UI; evaluates removal, background preservation and downstream generation quality, not game control.

note.zh: 核验Minecraft MCU闭环成功率/交互步数及四地图ViZDoom平均回报；不把世界模型预测质量当作游戏成绩。
note.en: Verified MCU closed-loop success/action counts and four-map ViZDoom episode rewards; prediction quality is not gameplay performance.

note.zh: 30 个游戏、124 个人工验证缺陷的漏洞发现评测；检测率属于软件 QA，不直接代表游戏能力。
note.en: Bug discovery over 30 games and 124 validated bugs; detection rate measures software QA, not gameplay capability.

note.zh: 合成可执行训练环境的自博弈方法；主要评价数学、代码、推理和工具使用迁移，不是固定游戏操控测试集。
note.en: Self-play synthesis of executable training environments; evaluation targets transfer to reasoning, code and tool use, not a fixed gameplay test suite.

note.zh: 生成视频的物理、几何与交互一致性评价；长视频一致性不能直接解释为 Agent 长时程执行能力。
note.en: Evaluates generated-video physics, geometry and interaction fidelity; long-video consistency does not establish long-horizon agent execution.

note.zh: 100 份长篇 GDD 的端到端开发评测；依据需求依赖契约衡量实现保真度。
note.en: End-to-end development from 100 long GDDs; dependency-aware contracts measure implementation fidelity.

note.zh: 70 项 Unreal 开发任务，以编译、资产和运行时断言通过情况评价提交。
note.en: Seventy Unreal development tasks evaluated by build, asset and runtime assertion checks.

note.zh: 47 项浏览器游戏生成任务；L1/L2 检查通过率与严格任务成功率评价软件实现。
note.en: Forty-seven browser-game generation tasks; L1/L2 pass rates and strict success assess software implementation.

note.zh: Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，评价程序行为正确性；角色动作属于被测程序输出，不是被评估模型的游戏策略。
note.en: Godot logic implementation and repair evaluates program behaviour; character actions are outputs of the implemented software, not the evaluated model’s gameplay policy.

note.zh: 通过观察和交互复刻 25 种游戏的 125 项开发任务；评价视觉、实现及规则一致性。
note.en: Replicates 125 tasks across 25 games through observation and interaction; evaluates visual, implementation and rule consistency.

note.zh: GameGen、GameFix、GameOpt 三条开发轨道，评价生成质量、缺陷修复和跨轮优化保真度；不映射到玩家能力。
note.en: GameGen, GameFix and GameOpt assess creation, repair and iterative optimization fidelity, not player capabilities.

note.zh: 评测视频世界模型对初始物体的存在、身份和结构保持；不是 Agent 对历史信息的记忆测试。
note.en: Measures preservation of initial objects’ presence, identity and structure in video world models, not agent recall.

note.zh: 正文明确 RL 训练每局抽新种子、最终 checkpoint 在 8 个留出种子评价；三训练种子与 20 人人类实验是不同统计层次。保留已核验八游戏交互单位，未向其他生成变体复制控制能力。
note.en: The paper samples a new training seed each episode and evaluates final checkpoints on eight held-out seeds. Three training seeds and twenty human participants are different statistical levels; retain the eight reviewed games without copying tags to other variants.

note.zh: 对照可执行世界记录评价生成视频的逻辑渲染对齐与交互事件实现；不计入游戏玩家控制或记忆。
note.en: Checks generated-video logic/render alignment and event realization against executable records, not player control or memory.

note.zh: 247 项 Godot/Unity 开发、修复与迁移任务；执行检查和视觉评分评价游戏产物。
note.en: 247 Godot/Unity construction, repair and porting tasks; runtime checks and visual rubrics evaluate produced games.

note.zh: 核验118游戏的文本状态交互与行为指标；每步不提供历史，因此不把该默认设置标成记忆评测。 本轮归属复核：具体关联六游戏跨模型子集，GVGAI的Zelda/Sokoban等实现与原版分开。118游戏初筛未作为同等跨模型覆盖；共同单位不统一赋能力，另提取推箱子空间规划子任务。
note.en: Verified textual interaction and behavior metrics across 118 games; the default per-step setup supplies no history and is not labelled a memory evaluation. Routing review: Route the six-game cross-model subset as distinct GVGAI implementations. The 118-game preliminary sweep is not equivalent cross-model coverage; the shared unit remains unlabelled, with box-pushing spatial planning extracted separately.

note.zh: LLM 扮演 RPG 引擎：创建世界并模拟状态更新；规则一致性和内容质量评测不等同于玩家规划或社交。
note.en: LLMs act as RPG engines, creating worlds and simulating state updates; mechanics and content quality do not directly assess player planning or social skill.

note.zh: 截图与视频 QA：视觉单元/回归测试、异常检测和报告生成；没有游戏行动闭环。
note.en: Image/video QA covers visual unit/regression tests, glitches and reports; there is no gameplay action loop.

detail.zh: 其他Gymnasium环境不继承本任务覆盖。
detail.en: Other Gymnasium environments do not inherit this coverage.

note.zh: 补入当前官方 CartPole-v1 平衡控制任务，已有真实动作、状态、回报和终止规则；平台性质不再作为排除理由。
note.en: Added official CartPole-v1 balancing with concrete actions, state, return and termination; platform status is not an exclusion.

detail.zh: 原实验提交版本未固定；Sampling与Balance未独立补齐。
detail.en: Original experiment commit is unpinned; Sampling and Balance remain separate work.

note.zh: 结合论文Navigation实验和官方任务配置，补入VMAS导航。当前配置shared_rew=False，未误写为统一共享奖励。
note.en: Integrated VMAS Navigation using the paper experiment and official task config; shared_rew=False is explicit rather than assuming shared rewards.

note.zh: 全文补清 SMAX、MPE、MABrax 与原环境等价性边界：MPE 用 1000 随机轨迹逐状态比对，Hanabi 用 10000 轨迹；MABrax 与 MAMuJoCo 不可直接比分。保留 SMAX 微操协议，速度基准不新增能力标签。
note.en: The full paper checks MPE with 1,000 random rollouts and Hanabi with 10,000 trajectories; MABrax is not directly score-comparable to MAMuJoCo. Retain SMAX micromanagement; throughput benchmarks add no capability tags.

note.zh: 全文 §4 明确 MPE/SMACv1/MAMuJoCo 分别训练 50k/100k/200k 次更新，训练结束评估 32 局、重复 10 种子。已补进离线 SMAC 单位；禁止把在线挑选最佳 checkpoint 的预算隐去。
note.en: Section 4 uses 50k/100k/200k updates for MPE/SMACv1/MAMuJoCo, then 32 evaluation episodes across ten seeds. Added SMAC controls; online checkpoint-selection budget must not be hidden.

note.zh: 核验原论文的 CookingWorld、TWC 和 Coin Collector 三项协议；额外库扩展不混入论文范围。
note.en: Verified the original CookingWorld, TWC and Coin Collector protocols; later library additions are kept separate.

note.zh: 全文明确 OpenXLand 在目标条件满足的每一步给 +1，而 trial 长度为用户指定；六个百万规模数据集是生成资源，不是六种已完成能力测量。保留既有规则探索协议，具体预算必须随配置提供。
note.en: OpenXLand gives +1 on each step satisfying the goal, while trial length is user-configured. Six million-scale datasets are generated resources, not six completed capability measurements; retain the rule-exploration protocol with explicit configured budgets.

detail.zh: 原MPE与后续MPE2默认参数不同，不能合并为同一复现实验。
detail.en: Original MPE and later MPE2 defaults differ and are not one reproduced experiment.

note.zh: 论文附录B的MPE Simple Spread是可明确执行和计分的平台示例，按地标覆盖协作纳入；不声称所有平台环境已核验。
note.en: The paper’s MPE Simple Spread example is executable and scored; integrated its landmark-coverage coordination without claiming platform-wide verification.

note.zh: 再次核对 CORA 的任务序列与评价定义：Forward/Backward Transfer 衡量训练序列中的迁移和遗忘，不能当单局工作记忆。保留 Procgen/MiniHack 的已核验单位；Atari/CHORES 各子任务的完整配置尚未逐一转录。 本轮归属复核：仅关联CORA实际顺序训练的六款Procgen游戏，不拓展到Procgen全16款。
note.en: Rechecked CORA’s task sequences and metrics: forward/backward transfer concern transfer and forgetting across training, not within-episode working memory. Retain Procgen/MiniHack units; complete Atari/CHORES subtask configurations remain untranscribed. Routing review: Route only the six Procgen games actually trained sequentially in CORA, not all sixteen platform games.

detail.zh: 图6优化参数、随机种子与历史环境提交尚未全部固定。
detail.en: Figure 6 tuning, seeds and historical environment commit remain incompletely pinned.

note.zh: 论文图6除了吞吐还报告Pong实际PPO回报，已按明确控制任务补入；游戏得分与速度指标分开。
note.en: Figure 6 reports actual PPO return on Pong in addition to throughput; integrated the control task while separating gameplay score from speed.

note.zh: 合作 MARL 的统计评估方法研究，比较既有实验的可靠性；不是新增游戏任务。
note.en: Studies statistical methodology for cooperative MARL evaluation; it does not introduce new gameplay tasks.

note.zh: 全文比较的算法交互预算按在/离策略和环境区分，评估 41 次各 100 局；这些设定仅用于既有 LBF/RWARE 单位。SMAC/MPE/矩阵游戏需各自明确任务和指标，暂不继承该协议。
note.en: The paper separates training budgets by on/off-policy algorithms and environment, with 41 evaluations of 100 episodes. These controls apply to the retained LBF/RWARE units; SMAC/MPE/matrix games require their own protocols.

detail.zh: 当前v6与2021论文版本不能视为完全相同。
detail.en: Current v6 is not assumed identical to the 2021 paper version.

note.zh: 补入官方Pistonball-v6局部视觉、多活塞协作与共享进展奖励；该版本的控制任务已可核对，其他环境不复制标签。
note.en: Added official Pistonball-v6 local vision, coordinated pistons and shared progress rewards; other environments inherit no labels.

note.zh: rliable 是统计分析方法：区间估计、IQM、性能分布等；使用 Atari/Procgen/DMC 的结果不构成新的游戏任务。
note.en: rliable supplies statistical analysis such as intervals, IQM and performance profiles; reuse of Atari/Procgen/DMC results is not a new gameplay task.

note.zh: 核验 3 个控制域的 12 项任务及无奖励预训练→有奖励适应协议；这些是连续控制环境，不是商业游戏。 本轮归属复核：限定官方表中的walker四个下游控制任务；作为抽象控制任务登记，不能算四款商业游戏，也不继承整个DMC任务库。 限定官方表中的quadruped四个下游控制任务；作为抽象控制任务登记，不能算四款商业游戏，也不继承整个DMC任务库。 限定官方表中的jaco四个下游控制任务；作为抽象控制任务登记，不能算四款商业游戏，也不继承整个DMC任务库。
note.en: Verified 12 tasks in 3 control domains and reward-free pretraining followed by rewarded adaptation; these are control environments, not commercial games. Routing review: Scope to the four official downstream walker tasks, recorded as abstract control tasks rather than commercial games or the entire DMC library. Scope to the four official downstream quadruped tasks, recorded as abstract control tasks rather than commercial games or the entire DMC library. Scope to the four official downstream jaco tasks, recorded as abstract control tasks rather than commercial games or the entire DMC library.

note.zh: 重新核对控制实验与世界模型诊断的区分：Atari100k、Crafter、五个 ViZDoom 场景为闭环回报，MiniGrid 的预测一致性实验不计记忆操控能力。既有任务范围保持，训练曲线不是逐模型统一试玩协议。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
note.en: Rechecked control versus world-model diagnostics: Atari100k, Crafter and five ViZDoom scenarios measure closed-loop returns, whereas MiniGrid prediction consistency is not memory-control performance. Retain those bounded units; learning curves are not a uniform model-play protocol. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

note.zh: DOOM 神经模拟器，评价画面预测、交互帧率与稳定性；采集数据的 RL 策略不是本文独立能力基准。
note.en: A DOOM neural simulator evaluates visual prediction, interactive frame rate and stability; its data-collection policy is not a separate capability benchmark.

note.zh: 评测世界模型在长 rollout 后重现历史画面的能力；属于生成时序一致性，不是玩家记忆。
note.en: Tests reconstruction of past visual context after long world-model rollouts; temporal generation consistency is not player memory.

note.zh: 完整论文区分 Atari100k 策略评估与 CS:GO 交互生成演示。前者以真实交互预算、逐游戏回报/人类归一化分评价；后者没有可替代原游戏对战胜率的评测，继续只保留 Atari 单位。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
note.en: The full paper separates Atari100k policy evaluation from interactive CS:GO generation. Real-interaction budgets and game/human-normalized returns apply to Atari; CS:GO generation does not supply native-match wins. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

note.zh: 附录 E 的 CoinRun 实验需要将潜在动作映射到真实动作，并用标注示范进行行为克隆；保留该对照任务，生成视频质量或潜在动作可控性不新增游戏能力。
note.en: Appendix E’s CoinRun experiment maps latent to real actions and performs behavioral cloning using labelled demonstrations. Retain that controlled task; generated video quality and latent controllability add no gameplay capabilities.

note.zh: MAP-Elites 生成 FPS 地图，以拓扑与玩法诱发特征评价质量和多样性，目标是内容生成。
note.en: MAP-Elites generates FPS maps and evaluates topology, gameplay-induced features, quality and diversity; this is content generation.

note.zh: 程序化内容生成综述；无独立游戏行动协议或可运行评测任务。
note.en: A procedural-content-generation survey, without an independent gameplay protocol or runnable evaluation task.

note.zh: 分层 WaveFunction Collapse 生成满足约束的关卡；指标针对结构、可控性和多样性。
note.en: Hierarchical WaveFunction Collapse generates constrained levels; evaluation concerns structure, controllability and diversity.

note.zh: 根据文本生成 Mario 关卡；关卡可玩性与多样性评价不直接证明模型会玩 Mario。
note.en: Generates Mario levels from text; level playability and diversity do not establish that the model plays Mario.

note.zh: 动作模仿与虚拟角色运动控制方法；当前归属未提供具体游戏目标评测，不计入游戏能力图。
note.en: Motion imitation and virtual-character control method; the current attribution lacks a specific gameplay-goal protocol and is excluded from gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 从潜变量生成三维场景与新视角；评价场景生成质量，不是游戏决策。
note.en: Generates 3D scenes and novel views from latent variables; evaluates scene quality, not game decisions.

note.zh: 生成可漫游三维场景的辐射场模型；没有 Agent 在游戏中选择动作完成目标的评测。
note.en: Generates navigable radiance-field scenes; no agent gameplay goal-completion evaluation is specified.

note.zh: 局部辐射场场景生成与补全；自由相机是渲染条件，不是游戏策略。
note.en: Scene generation and completion with local radiance fields; camera movement conditions rendering rather than a gameplay policy.

note.zh: AAAI 全文核实 100 次会话形成 2550 指令—动作样本，主要指标为指令准确率、实体 P/R/F1、QPS 和延迟；24 名玩家比较四模式的主观偏好。不能把偏好分或样本纠错准确率当闭环胜率，暂不新增九维操控单位。
note.en: The AAAI paper specifies 2,550 instruction-action examples from 100 sessions, instruction/entity accuracy, QPS and latency, plus subjective preferences from 24 players across four modes. These are not closed-loop win rates.

note.zh: 按语言交互生成动漫状态和动画片段；评价生成一致性和体验，不是固定规则下的玩家策略。
note.en: Generates anime states and animation clips from language interaction; evaluates generation consistency and experience, not player policies under fixed rules.

note.zh: 正文和任务附录将 Minecraft 任务完成、人格/行为多样性、游戏测试代码覆盖分开；保留已核验钻石任务。Shattered Pixel Dungeon 的测试覆盖不能直接当通关或战斗能力，尚缺可比较的完整终局评估协议。
note.en: The main text and task appendix distinguish Minecraft completion, persona/behavior diversity and testing code coverage. Retain the diamond task; Shattered Pixel Dungeon coverage does not establish completion/combat ability without a comparable terminal evaluation protocol.

note.zh: 256 名人类玩家的多模态生理与行为数据集；不将人类记录当成模型游戏任务表现。
note.en: Multimodal physiological/behavioural data from 256 human players; human recordings are not model gameplay evaluations.

note.zh: 同步第一视角视频上的队友/对手位置预测；感知预测结果不能直接代表闭环多 Agent 协作。
note.en: Predicts teammate/opponent positions from synchronized egocentric footage; perception results do not establish closed-loop multi-agent coordination.

note.zh: 比较 AI Director 的任务分配对人类体验的影响；不是玩家 Agent 的任务执行基准。
note.en: Compares effects of AI-director quest selection on human experience, not player-agent execution.

note.zh: 优化匹配公平性与参与度的配对系统；不评价局内操控。
note.en: Optimizes matchmaking fairness and engagement, not in-game control.

note.zh: 从游戏视频预测人类情感并与自评/传感器对照；不评价游戏策略。
note.en: Predicts human affect from gameplay video against self-report/sensors, not gameplay policies.

note.zh: 根据角色与补丁信息预测 Dota 2 击杀结果；AUC 衡量预测模型，非 Agent 对局能力。
note.en: Predicts Dota 2 kill outcomes from character/patch information; AUC evaluates prediction, not agent play.

note.zh: 核验HAWK为CS:GO服务端作弊识别，使用多视角行为特征判断作弊类型与程度；属于反作弊检测，不是Agent游戏操控评测。
note.en: HAWK detects cheating in CS:GO using server-side multi-view behavior features; it evaluates detection, not agent gameplay control.

note.zh: 服务器端辅助瞄准作弊检测；检测精度和开销属于安全评测。
note.en: Server-side aim-assist cheat detection; detection quality and overhead are security evaluation.

note.zh: 游戏作弊与反作弊系统综述；不包含独立的游戏 Agent 任务组合。
note.en: A systematization of cheating and anti-cheat research, without an independent game-agent task suite.

note.zh: 从 CS2 数据窗口检测作弊，准确率与 AUC 评价分类，不是游戏策略。
note.en: Classifies cheating in CS2 data windows; accuracy and AUC measure detection, not game policies.

note.zh: 视觉扰动防御瞄准外挂；评估防御效果和视觉质量，不是玩家能力。
note.en: Visual perturbations defend against aimbots; evaluation concerns defence and visual quality, not player capability.

note.zh: 客户端外挂检测的准确率与运行开销评价；不计入游戏能力覆盖。
note.en: Evaluates client-side aimbot detection accuracy and runtime overhead; excluded from gameplay capability coverage.

note.zh: GAN 辅助瞄准的安全威胁研究，评价性能影响与可检测性；不作为合法游戏 Agent 基准。
note.en: Studies GAN-assisted aiming as a security threat, evaluating performance effects and detectability; not a general game-agent benchmark.

note.zh: 本地及作者官网全文确认研究实时超分辨率；CS2、OW2、TF2 是画质素材/系统测试场景。指标不是 Agent 游戏表现，保留游戏关联但不计覆盖图。
note.en: Local and author-hosted full text confirms real-time super-resolution. CS2, OW2 and TF2 provide content/system scenarios, not agent-performance tasks; game links remain outside capability coverage.

note.zh: 结合 EEG 与行为信息辅助人类识别目标；收敛与人类表现指标属于人机辅助研究。
note.en: Combines EEG and behavioural signals to assist human target detection; convergence and human performance measure assistive interaction.

detail.zh: My Way Home等其余场景的具体代码动作绑定尚未完成；已知完成时间不替代该绑定。
detail.en: Code-level action bindings remain for My Way Home and other scenarios; known completion times do not replace them.

note.zh: 本地作者全文和官方训练命令共同确认Basic AI任务、左右移动/射击、视听条件与5亿步回报比较，已纳入；人类击杀率不参与该单元。
note.en: The local author full text and official commands verify Basic AI actions, audiovisual conditions and 500-million-step return evaluation; human kill rates are excluded.

note.zh: 生成因果连贯故事情节，以人类质量判断评测；不是交互游戏行动测试。
note.en: Generates causally coherent story plots evaluated by human quality judgements, not interactive gameplay actions.

note.zh: 从肖像创建游戏角色面部形状和纹理；属于资产生成。
note.en: Creates character facial shape and texture from portraits; this is asset generation.

note.zh: 从无标注视频学习动作条件生成；评价视频合成及动作语义一致性。
note.en: Learns action-conditioned generation from unlabelled video; evaluates video synthesis and action semantics.

note.zh: Nature 正文现已核实 Minecraft 每局随机世界、死亡或 36000 步终止、12 项稀疏奖励物品链，并明确抽象合成和加速破坏方块；移除仅旧预印本支持此设置的限制。各领域仍为重新训练，非单策略零样本泛化。
note.en: The Nature text verifies random Minecraft worlds, death/36,000-step termination, a twelve-item sparse-reward chain, abstract crafting and accelerated block breaking. The old-preprint-only caveat is removed; domains still involve retraining rather than zero-shot policy transfer.

note.zh: 核验GT Sophy的计时赛与对战评测；输入是引擎状态而非视觉图像，10Hz连续控制。对战战术与单车控制分开。
note.en: Verified GT Sophy time trials and races using engine-state observations and 10 Hz continuous control; racing tactics are separated from solo control.

note.zh: WHAM/Muse 生成、延续和编辑 Bleeding Edge 片段；一致性、多样性、编辑持久性不是玩家通关指标。
note.en: WHAM/Muse generates, continues and edits Bleeding Edge sequences; consistency, diversity and edit persistence are not player completion metrics.

detail.zh: 其他5个平台的逐任务动作/观测设置尚未逐一绑定。
detail.en: Per-task action/observation settings for the other five platforms remain unbound.

note.zh: 将DiscoRL在Crafter重新训练策略的平均回报评测纳入，区分学习规则迁移与策略零样本泛化，也不混用Crafter几何均分。
note.en: Integrated DiscoRL policy retraining on Crafter using average return, distinguishing learning-rule transfer from zero-shot policy transfer and Crafter geometric-mean score.

note.zh: Nature 全文核实 1808 局/9892 步的人类动作似然、观看判断的 TVD/JS 距离；与随机对手 120 次自博弈用于计算趣味性特征，并非独立游戏智能体排行榜。因此不新增九维交互任务。
note.en: The full Nature article evaluates human-action likelihood over 1,808 matches/9,892 moves and TVD/JS for judgments. The 120 self-play runs against random opponents compute funness features, not an independent game-agent benchmark.

note.zh: 将人类游戏目标写成奖励程序并生成新目标，使用人类评价衡量有趣性/人类相似性；不评估执行目标的 Agent。
note.en: Represents human goals as reward programs and generates new goals, assessed for fun and human-likeness; does not evaluate agents executing those goals.

note.zh: 核验十轮重复2×2博弈协议、双方动作/收益历史及SCoT对照；抽象博弈不计入电子游戏类型。
note.en: Verified ten-round repeated 2×2 protocols, joint action/payoff history and SCoT comparisons; these are abstract games, not videogame genres.

note.zh: 编码 Agent 维护世界状态并驱动视频渲染；评价规则一致性和视觉实现，不将世界模拟能力当成玩家能力。
note.en: A coding agent maintains world state and drives video rendering; rule consistency and visual realization are not player capability.

note.zh: 控制的是合成视频，没有原引擎游戏目标或在线 agent 通关协议；未展开全部数据游戏。
note.en: Controls generated video; no native-engine agent goal or completion protocol. Full game roster is not expanded.

note.zh: 未评价 Minecraft 原引擎中的 agent 任务成功；赛车仅定性扩展示例，未确认具体赛车游戏。
note.en: No native Minecraft agent task-success evaluation. Racing is qualitative, with no confirmed named racing title.

note.zh: VLM 是视频评委，不是被测游戏玩家；没有原游戏 goal-driven 在线任务。
note.en: VLM is a video judge, not the tested player. No native-game goal-driven online task.

note.zh: 世界模型记忆不是 agent 记忆测试；未核得可对应具体游戏的录像名单。
note.en: World-model memory is not agent-memory testing. No verified title roster for game-level attribution.

note.zh: 报告中的长时记忆是生成画面一致性；没有命名游戏的任务完成评价。
note.en: Long-horizon memory concerns generated visual consistency; no named-game task-completion evaluation.

note.zh: GRPO 是代码生成训练，不是 RL 游戏玩家；未报告生成模型的在线对局胜率。
note.en: GRPO trains code generation rather than RL gameplay; no online match win-rate evaluation is reported.

note.zh: VLM 只判定生成画面；未测试 FPS agent 的原生游戏胜负或击杀目标。
