note.en: VLM judges generated visuals only; no native FPS agent win/loss or combat-goal evaluation.

note.zh: 评价开发代理修改项目的能力；Godot 是引擎，任务中出现 RTS/FPS 不代表对应游玩评测。官方复现要求 Godot 4.4.1；本文与网站最新榜单可能版本不同。
note.en: Evaluates project editing by coding agents; Godot is an engine and RTS/FPS examples are not gameplay evaluations. Official validation requires Godot 4.4.1; paper and live leaderboard versions differ.

note.zh: 评价生成游戏产物，不是独立玩家代理的通关能力；家族名称不能直接变成商业游戏关联。
note.en: Scores generated artifacts rather than a standalone player agent; genre families do not imply named commercial-game links.

note.zh: UE5 是引擎；评估代码变更，不是 FPS/RTS 游玩。论文指向 Nitrode-Research/GameEngineBench，但本轮无法取回仓库页，未把链接当作已核验公开代码。
note.en: UE5 is an engine; evaluates code changes, not FPS/RTS play. The paper points to Nitrode-Research/GameEngineBench, but its page could not be retrieved in this pass, so code availability is unconfirmed.

note.zh: 训练集与 300 项评测集需分开；运行行为验证针对生成代码。完整子项目归属未在本轮逐项展开。
note.en: Training and the 300-project evaluation split are distinct; runtime verification evaluates generated code. Individual project/game membership was not fully expanded in this pass.

note.zh: 验收生成应用，不评价玩家模型；可用率不代表完整需求满足。部分项目形似 UNO/俄罗斯方块，不等于评测原版游戏。
note.en: Evaluates delivered applications rather than player models; usability does not equal full specification satisfaction. UNO/Tetris-like artifacts do not imply original-game evaluations.

note.zh: 浏览器执行/VLM judging 用于验收开发产物；不加入玩家能力覆盖。模型训练包含执行奖励 RL，不表示新增 RL 游玩任务。
note.en: Browser execution/VLM judging evaluates development artifacts, not player capability coverage. Execution-reward RL trains the coding model, not a new RL gameplay task.

note.zh: 分步浏览器 playtester 和独立 judge 检验产物；不能据此认定生成器具有玩家规划/控制能力。
note.en: A step-driven browser playtester and independent judge inspect artifacts; this does not establish the generator as a capable game-playing planner/controller.

note.zh: GUI playtester 提供修复反馈，最终得分仍衡量生成游戏质量；不自动计为通用玩家 benchmark。
note.en: The GUI playtester supplies repair feedback; final scores measure generated-game quality rather than a general player benchmark.

note.zh: 报告为系统与案例分析；未确认统一独立玩家测试集，不从创意案例推断稳定能力提升。
note.en: A system/case-study report; a unified independent player test set is not established, and creative examples do not establish stable capability gains.

note.zh: 身份/账号一致性识别，既不控制游戏，也不按这些特征评价 agent 的 FPS 水平。
note.en: Identity/account consistency recognition; does not control gameplay or evaluate agent FPS proficiency.

note.zh: RFT/SFT 的动作预测准确率是离线指标，不等于完整导航成功率；不测生存、制作或通关。部分数据表 Base/Extend 标记与正文存在差异，使用具体表行和版本。
note.en: RFT/SFT action-prediction accuracy is offline, not complete-navigation success; survival/crafting/completion are excluded. Some Base/Extend table labels differ from prose; preserve table/version context.

note.zh: 评估生成世界模型；已给动作脚本，不测试 agent 选行动、协商或真实生存能力。十项模型指标不进入玩家能力覆盖。
note.en: Evaluates generated world models under supplied action scripts, not agent action choice, negotiation or survival; model metrics do not enter player-capability coverage.

note.zh: 动作是深度传感器/相机导航；不在 ViZDoom 中打敌人，不测瞄准、射击或 FPS 战绩。
note.en: Actions move a depth-sensor/camera; this is not ViZDoom combat and does not test aiming, shooting or FPS match performance.

note.zh: 这是人类认知研究；推断的人类规划深度不直接构成Agent规划benchmark。仓库及完整移动数据开放性未在本轮确认。
note.en: A human cognition study, not an autonomous-agent planning benchmark. A current official repository and full mobile-data availability were not confirmed in this pass.

note.zh: Agent扮演网络规划器而非普通合作/背叛玩家。OSF开放数据与分析脚本，不等同完整训练/部署平台。
note.en: The agent is a network planner, not a cooperate/defect player. OSF data and analysis scripts do not establish a full released training/deployment platform.

note.zh: 是机制设计者的评测，不是普通玩家的自主游戏控制；公开仓库主要提供人类数据和图表复现。
note.en: Evaluates a mechanism designer rather than autonomous gameplay as a participant; the released repository primarily supports human-data analysis and figure reproduction.

note.zh: 主分析限每局前60手，是历史观察性分析而非新Agent在线对弈benchmark。
note.en: The main analysis uses the first 60 moves and is historical observational research, not a new online agent-playing benchmark.

note.zh: 核心论文协议是离线人类行为预测；可在线使用的模型不等于该论文报告了自主对局评测。
note.en: The core reported protocol is offline human-behavior prediction; deployment as a bot does not itself establish a reported gameplay tournament.

note.zh: Peak原始行为数据按协议不公开；模型拟合和网络可向作者申请；没有将此分析当作Agent规划能力证据。
note.en: Peak behavioral data are not public under the agreement; trained networks and fits are request-only. This analysis is not evidence of autonomous-agent planning capability.

note.zh: 综述中提到的游戏和编辑器不是本文实际评测游戏，不展开为在线任务。
note.en: Mentioned games and editors are survey examples, not evaluated gameplay tasks.

note.zh: RL动作编辑关卡而非控制Minecraft玩家，不计游玩在线任务或玩家控制能力。
note.en: RL actions edit levels rather than control a Minecraft player; excluded from gameplay online tasks and player-control coverage.

note.zh: 评价关卡生成而非推箱子Agent；最终出版全文未在本轮取得，方法细节以可公开核对内容为限。
note.en: Evaluates level generation rather than a Sokoban-playing agent; the final published full text was not obtained in this pass.

note.zh: 对应Overwatch而非Overwatch 2；人类语音数据不代表Agent操控或多Agent协作benchmark。
note.en: Original Overwatch, not Overwatch 2; human speech data do not establish an agent-control or multi-agent-cooperation benchmark.

note.zh: 剑盾是动画角色设定，不是具体商业格斗游戏；不计游戏游玩覆盖。仓库已提示弃用并指向MimicKit。
note.en: Sword/shield is an animation character configuration, not a named fighting game; outside gameplay coverage. The repository is deprecated in favor of MimicKit.

note.zh: 角色动画并非具体游戏游玩；当前公开SMPL检查点明确不支持文本控制，不能把论文所有模态当作现成可运行功能。
note.en: Character animation is not a specific game-playing task. The current public SMPL checkpoint explicitly lacks text control; paper modalities are not all shipped features.

note.zh: 足球运球是动作合成演示，未确认足球游戏规则、对手或比赛协议，不能映射为体育游戏benchmark。
note.en: Soccer dribbling is a motion-synthesis demonstration without a verified football-game match protocol, opponent or scoring system.

note.zh: 论文描述实时角色动画创作；未确认具体游戏环境或官方独立代码发布，不计在线游戏任务。
note.en: The paper concerns real-time animation authoring; no specific gameplay environment or official standalone code release was confirmed.

note.zh: 是动画任务规划与控制；并非有规则和对手的游戏benchmark，不把运动规划直接加入游戏Agent覆盖。
note.en: Animation planning/control, not a game benchmark with rules and opponents; motion planning does not automatically enter game-agent coverage.

note.zh: 主要方法使用解析物理梯度而非RL；不能因比较RL基线就标为RL算法。没有具体游戏游玩评测。
note.en: The main method uses analytic physics gradients rather than RL; RL baselines do not make it an RL method. No named gameplay evaluation.

note.zh: 虚拟角色控制而非具体游戏玩家控制；视频/文本来源不使该策略成为VLM或LLM。
note.en: Virtual-avatar control, not player control in a specific game; video/text motion sources do not make the policy an LLM or VLM.

note.zh: 评测产物的物理设计与控制，不是LLM逐帧直接玩商业游戏或现实机器人能力；独立节点，仅相关研究，不计游戏Arena在线覆盖。
note.en: Evaluates physical-design/control artifacts, not frame-by-frame LLM play in a commercial game or real-world robotics. Kept as a distinct adjacent node outside gameplay Arena coverage.

note.zh: GameQA 是从游戏生成的可验证视觉推理训练数据；跨域收益不能视为在 30 款游戏中实际游玩的能力覆盖。
note.en: GameQA is verifiable visual-reasoning training data generated from games; transfer gains do not establish interactive play coverage across the 30 source games.

note.zh: 先游玩生成个人轨迹，但正式记分任务是经历记忆问答（ACC/F1），不是通过游戏动作达成目标；保留为记忆研究，不把源游戏计入当前交互游玩能力图。
note.en: Gameplay generates individualized trajectories, but the scored task is memory QA (ACC/F1), not game-goal achievement through actions. Retained as memory research outside the interactive-play capability map.

note.zh: 研究从视频预测键盘动作的逆动力学模型；作为方法研究保留，不将模型结构或方法收益直接记作独立基准覆盖。
note.en: Studies inverse-dynamics prediction of key presses from video; retained as method research, without turning architecture or method improvements into independent benchmark coverage.

note.zh: 全文III明确MM-SA-Bench统一多选题，另一部分为玩家特质归因与策略预测；测试战场截图/行为信息的理解，不让代理在MiaoSuan中下达闭环指令。保留问答与推理研究，移出游玩覆盖。
note.en: Section III uses multiple-choice situational-awareness questions; the other component tests trait attribution and strategy prediction. These reason over screenshots/behavior rather than issue closed-loop MiaoSuan commands; excluded from gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 作者全文确认是现实体育转播视频理解/生成与工具辅助分析。即使 T9 使用 Agent 工具，其输出仍是分析回答，不是游戏动作，不进入游玩能力覆盖图。
note.en: Full text confirms real-world sports video understanding/generation and tool-assisted analysis. T9 agents answer analysis questions rather than control gameplay, so no play-capability unit is added.

note.zh: 从合法走子序列重建每步完整棋盘状态。 指标：ExactState全部75项正确；标签准确率与轨迹精确性。 无选招或对手对战；不能解读为国际象棋棋力。 保留诊断文献，不计入交互游玩能力覆盖。
note.en: Reconstruct the complete board state from legal move sequences. Metrics: ExactState requires all 75 labels; label accuracy and trajectory exactness. No move selection or opponents; not chess playing strength. Retained as diagnostic literature, excluded from interactive gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 全文3.1–3.3与算法1/2确认静态最终线索与动态历史日志回放；动态线索按原人类对局更新并注入人类错误猜测，不由模型与真人实时协商产生。指标为found rate/猜测数，暂不计闭环社会协作覆盖。
note.en: Sections3.1–3.3 and algorithms1/2 use final clues or replayed human logs. Dynamic clues follow the original game and inject human wrong guesses rather than live model-human negotiation. Found rate/guess count are retained, without closed-loop social coverage.

note.zh: 全文4–5及实验图表评估Nash/Stackelberg求解器：效用、运行时间、策略支持集与收敛，比较真实目标和随机化矩阵/日程。属于安全博弈求解实例，并非玩家逐回合观测行动的游戏代理协议，保留研究条目但不计游玩图。
note.en: Sections4–5 evaluate Nash/Stackelberg solvers through utility,runtime,support size and convergence on real versus randomized target/matrix/schedule instances. These are security-game solver problems, not turn-by-turn game-agent protocols; retained outside gameplay coverage.

note.zh: §2.1–2.5确认主要输出是均衡/策略组合答案，复杂形式要求全部子题正确；144类型及其故事改写是解题实例，不是持续互动游戏。按请求不生成游玩任务。
note.en: Sections 2.1–2.5 evaluate equilibrium/strategy-combination answers, including all-correct composite questions. The 144 classes and story variants are reasoning items rather than ongoing gameplay; no gameplay unit is added.

note.zh: 对97个场景的408条二元陈述判断真伪。 指标：四类能力准确率、macro-F1及宏平均。 静态问答，不测完整比赛、在线协作或运动控制。 保留诊断文献，不计入交互游玩能力覆盖。
note.en: Judge 408 binary statements across 97 scenarios. Metrics: Per-ability accuracy, macro-F1, and macro-average. Static QA, not complete games, online coordination, or motor control. Retained as diagnostic literature, excluded from interactive gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 核验§2–5：离散状态平稳均值场博弈求解，目标为策略与群体分布的不动点；MF-Garnets生成随机博弈并比较可利用度/收敛。属于求解器评测，不是电子游戏Agent交互成绩。
note.en: Sections 2–5 study fixed points of policy and population distribution in stationary discrete MFGs. MF-Garnets generates solver tests of exploitability/convergence, not videogame-agent gameplay.

note.zh: 分析已记录Hanabi出牌，比较字面信息下失败概率与实际失败。 指标：Convention Gap＝字面预测失败率−实际失败率。 非零值不是约定内容量或因果效应，也不是记忆测验。 保留诊断文献，不计入交互游玩能力覆盖。
note.en: Analyze logged Hanabi plays, comparing literal-information failure probability to observed failures. Metrics: Convention Gap = literal predicted failure minus observed failure. Nonzero gaps are neither convention information quantity nor causal effect or memory score. Retained as diagnostic literature, excluded from interactive gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 对1,224条狼人杀指控评估旁观村民的信念变化。 指标：按真实阵营与指控者信任分层的信念/变化；均值95%区间。 主观量表诊断，不是整局胜率；无法单靠信念幅度判断合理性。 保留诊断文献，不计入交互游玩能力覆盖。
note.en: Evaluate village observers’ belief changes for 1,224 Werewolf accusations. Metrics: Beliefs/shifts stratified by true role and accuser trust, with 95% mean intervals. Subjective-scale diagnostic, not win rate; shift size alone is not rationality. Retained as diagnostic literature, excluded from interactive gameplay coverage.

note.zh: Rushes 是人类互动叙事选择预测数据，评价个体偏好，不是游戏 Agent 的任务完成 benchmark。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: Rushes predicts human interactive-narrative choices and personalized preferences, not agent task completion. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: ChronoPlay 是游戏知识 RAG 问答与内容时效 benchmark，不属于游戏控制能力覆盖。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: ChronoPlay benchmarks game-domain RAG and information freshness, not gameplay control capabilities. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: JerichoWorld 是观测到知识图谱/有效动作的监督数据集，不是完整文字游戏通关 benchmark。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: JerichoWorld is supervised observation-to-graph/valid-action data, not a full text-game completion benchmark. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: 同步第一视角视频上的队友/对手位置预测；感知预测结果不能直接代表闭环多 Agent 协作。
note.en: Predicts teammate/opponent positions from synchronized egocentric footage; perception results do not establish closed-loop multi-agent coordination.

note.zh: 根据角色与补丁信息预测 Dota 2 击杀结果；AUC 衡量预测模型，非 Agent 对局能力。
note.en: Predicts Dota 2 kill outcomes from character/patch information; AUC evaluates prediction, not agent play.

note.zh: Nature 全文核实 1808 局/9892 步的人类动作似然、观看判断的 TVD/JS 距离；与随机对手 120 次自博弈用于计算趣味性特征，并非独立游戏智能体排行榜。因此不新增九维交互任务。
note.en: The full Nature article evaluates human-action likelihood over 1,808 matches/9,892 moves and TVD/JS for judgments. The 120 self-play runs against random opponents compute funness features, not an independent game-agent benchmark.

note.zh: 核心论文协议是离线人类行为预测；可在线使用的模型不等于该论文报告了自主对局评测。
note.en: The core reported protocol is offline human-behavior prediction; deployment as a bot does not itself establish a reported gameplay tournament.

detail.zh: 在线 Minecraft 的具体可执行动作格式与执行器尚未公开定位；项目仓库仍把在线环境列为发布计划，论文键绑定表属于数据注释，不能替代在线接口。
detail.en: The executable online Minecraft action format and executor remain unlocated. The repository lists online environments in its release roadmap; annotation keybindings do not establish the online interface.

note.zh: 在线 Minecraft 的具体可执行动作格式与执行器尚未公开定位；项目仓库仍把在线环境列为发布计划，论文键绑定表属于数据注释，不能替代在线接口。
note.en: The executable online Minecraft action format and executor remain unlocated. The repository lists online environments in its release roadmap; annotation keybindings do not establish the online interface.

detail.zh: PMLR 正式 PDF 再次读取失败，OpenReview 两个论文链接均进入验证页；可确认混合高低层动作与既往成功指标，但观测内容及其具体执行映射仍无法核对。
detail.en: The official PMLR PDF again failed to load and both OpenReview paper links required browser verification. Mixed hierarchical actions and previously recorded metrics are known, but observations and their executable mapping remain unverifiable.

note.zh: PMLR 正式 PDF 再次读取失败，OpenReview 两个论文链接均进入验证页；可确认混合高低层动作与既往成功指标，但观测内容及其具体执行映射仍无法核对。
note.en: The official PMLR PDF again failed to load and both OpenReview paper links required browser verification. Mixed hierarchical actions and previously recorded metrics are known, but observations and their executable mapping remain unverifiable.

detail.zh: 已新增核实官方 tasks.js 库存数量成功验证及超时设置；但该文件导入的 commands/index.js 返回 404，未取得完整游戏动作实现。发布任务目录与论文四类任务也尚未逐项对齐，不将代码示例等同论文全部评测。
detail.en: The official tasks.js now verifies inventory-quantity success and timeouts, but its imported commands/index.js returned 404, leaving the actual game-action implementation unavailable. Released task directories are not yet reconciled with the four paper families.

note.zh: 已新增核实官方 tasks.js 库存数量成功验证及超时设置；但该文件导入的 commands/index.js 返回 404，未取得完整游戏动作实现。发布任务目录与论文四类任务也尚未逐项对齐，不将代码示例等同论文全部评测。
note.en: The official tasks.js now verifies inventory-quantity success and timeouts, but its imported commands/index.js returned 404, leaving the actual game-action implementation unavailable. Released task directories are not yet reconciled with the four paper families.

note.zh: 全文3.1确认模型输出蓝图矩阵，Mineflayer自动建造；评分含GPT-4.1加权建筑质量与空间问答准确率，非闭环玩家操作。保留研究条目，移出交互游玩能力图。
note.en: Section 3.1 confirms blueprint-matrix output followed by automatic Mineflayer construction. Metrics include GPT-4.1-weighted artifact quality and spatial-QA accuracy, not closed-loop player control; retained as research but excluded from interactive coverage.

note.zh: 全文实验证据主要为单位参数平衡：随机/半随机队伍的大规模模拟、成对胜负矩阵和不同平衡损失比较；55K games/s是引擎吞吐。未定位固定学习代理与独立评测任务的完整协议，保留环境/设计研究，不新增能力任务。
note.en: Full-text experiments primarily evaluate unit-parameter balancing through random/semi-random teams, win-loss matrices and balancing losses;55K games/s is throughput. A complete fixed learning-agent evaluation protocol was not located, so no capability unit is added.

note.zh: NCP-Bench 评估叙事者保持承诺与事实一致性，不是玩家完成游戏任务的能力。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: NCP-Bench evaluates narrator commitment/fact consistency, not player task-completion ability. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: 多角色动作条件视频生成；评测动作绑定、身份一致性及画面质量，不是协作策略执行。
note.en: Multi-subject action-conditioned video generation evaluates action binding, identity consistency and visual quality, not cooperative policies.

note.zh: 编码 Agent 在固定算力内改进世界模型；指标为保留测试集动力学预测质量，不是游戏通关。
note.en: Coding agents improve a world model under fixed compute; held-out dynamics prediction is evaluated, not game completion.

note.zh: 从游戏视频移除 UI；评价去除质量、背景保留和下游生成质量，不计入游戏操控能力。
note.en: Removes gameplay UI; evaluates removal, background preservation and downstream generation quality, not game control.

note.zh: 30 个游戏、124 个人工验证缺陷的漏洞发现评测；检测率属于软件 QA，不直接代表游戏能力。
note.en: Bug discovery over 30 games and 124 validated bugs; detection rate measures software QA, not gameplay capability.

note.zh: 合成可执行训练环境的自博弈方法；主要评价数学、代码、推理和工具使用迁移，不是固定游戏操控测试集。
note.en: Self-play synthesis of executable training environments; evaluation targets transfer to reasoning, code and tool use, not a fixed gameplay test suite.

note.zh: 生成视频的物理、几何与交互一致性评价；长视频一致性不能直接解释为 Agent 长时程执行能力。
note.en: Evaluates generated-video physics, geometry and interaction fidelity; long-video consistency does not establish long-horizon agent execution.

note.zh: 100 份长篇 GDD 的端到端开发评测；依据需求依赖契约衡量实现保真度。
note.en: End-to-end development from 100 long GDDs; dependency-aware contracts measure implementation fidelity.

note.zh: 70 项 Unreal 开发任务，以编译、资产和运行时断言通过情况评价提交。
note.en: Seventy Unreal development tasks evaluated by build, asset and runtime assertion checks.

note.zh: 47 项浏览器游戏生成任务；L1/L2 检查通过率与严格任务成功率评价软件实现。
note.en: Forty-seven browser-game generation tasks; L1/L2 pass rates and strict success assess software implementation.

note.zh: Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，评价程序行为正确性；角色动作属于被测程序输出，不是被评估模型的游戏策略。
note.en: Godot logic implementation and repair evaluates program behaviour; character actions are outputs of the implemented software, not the evaluated model’s gameplay policy.

note.zh: 通过观察和交互复刻 25 种游戏的 125 项开发任务；评价视觉、实现及规则一致性。
note.en: Replicates 125 tasks across 25 games through observation and interaction; evaluates visual, implementation and rule consistency.

note.zh: GameGen、GameFix、GameOpt 三条开发轨道，评价生成质量、缺陷修复和跨轮优化保真度；不映射到玩家能力。
note.en: GameGen, GameFix and GameOpt assess creation, repair and iterative optimization fidelity, not player capabilities.

note.zh: 评测视频世界模型对初始物体的存在、身份和结构保持；不是 Agent 对历史信息的记忆测试。
note.en: Measures preservation of initial objects’ presence, identity and structure in video world models, not agent recall.

note.zh: 对照可执行世界记录评价生成视频的逻辑渲染对齐与交互事件实现；不计入游戏玩家控制或记忆。
note.en: Checks generated-video logic/render alignment and event realization against executable records, not player control or memory.

note.zh: 247 项 Godot/Unity 开发、修复与迁移任务；执行检查和视觉评分评价游戏产物。
note.en: 247 Godot/Unity construction, repair and porting tasks; runtime checks and visual rubrics evaluate produced games.

note.zh: LLM 扮演 RPG 引擎：创建世界并模拟状态更新；规则一致性和内容质量评测不等同于玩家规划或社交。
note.en: LLMs act as RPG engines, creating worlds and simulating state updates; mechanics and content quality do not directly assess player planning or social skill.

note.zh: 截图与视频 QA：视觉单元/回归测试、异常检测和报告生成；没有游戏行动闭环。
note.en: Image/video QA covers visual unit/regression tests, glitches and reports; there is no gameplay action loop.

note.zh: DOOM 神经模拟器，评价画面预测、交互帧率与稳定性；采集数据的 RL 策略不是本文独立能力基准。
note.en: A DOOM neural simulator evaluates visual prediction, interactive frame rate and stability; its data-collection policy is not a separate capability benchmark.

note.zh: 评测世界模型在长 rollout 后重现历史画面的能力；属于生成时序一致性，不是玩家记忆。
note.en: Tests reconstruction of past visual context after long world-model rollouts; temporal generation consistency is not player memory.

note.zh: MAP-Elites 生成 FPS 地图，以拓扑与玩法诱发特征评价质量和多样性，目标是内容生成。
note.en: MAP-Elites generates FPS maps and evaluates topology, gameplay-induced features, quality and diversity; this is content generation.

note.zh: 分层 WaveFunction Collapse 生成满足约束的关卡；指标针对结构、可控性和多样性。
note.en: Hierarchical WaveFunction Collapse generates constrained levels; evaluation concerns structure, controllability and diversity.

note.zh: 根据文本生成 Mario 关卡；关卡可玩性与多样性评价不直接证明模型会玩 Mario。
note.en: Generates Mario levels from text; level playability and diversity do not establish that the model plays Mario.

note.zh: 从潜变量生成三维场景与新视角；评价场景生成质量，不是游戏决策。
note.en: Generates 3D scenes and novel views from latent variables; evaluates scene quality, not game decisions.

note.zh: 生成可漫游三维场景的辐射场模型；没有 Agent 在游戏中选择动作完成目标的评测。
note.en: Generates navigable radiance-field scenes; no agent gameplay goal-completion evaluation is specified.

note.zh: 局部辐射场场景生成与补全；自由相机是渲染条件，不是游戏策略。
note.en: Scene generation and completion with local radiance fields; camera movement conditions rendering rather than a gameplay policy.

note.zh: 按语言交互生成动漫状态和动画片段；评价生成一致性和体验，不是固定规则下的玩家策略。
note.en: Generates anime states and animation clips from language interaction; evaluates generation consistency and experience, not player policies under fixed rules.

note.zh: 本地及作者官网全文确认研究实时超分辨率；CS2、OW2、TF2 是画质素材/系统测试场景。指标不是 Agent 游戏表现，保留游戏关联但不计覆盖图。
note.en: Local and author-hosted full text confirms real-time super-resolution. CS2, OW2 and TF2 provide content/system scenarios, not agent-performance tasks; game links remain outside capability coverage.

note.zh: 生成因果连贯故事情节，以人类质量判断评测；不是交互游戏行动测试。
note.en: Generates causally coherent story plots evaluated by human quality judgements, not interactive gameplay actions.

note.zh: 从肖像创建游戏角色面部形状和纹理；属于资产生成。
note.en: Creates character facial shape and texture from portraits; this is asset generation.

note.zh: 从无标注视频学习动作条件生成；评价视频合成及动作语义一致性。
note.en: Learns action-conditioned generation from unlabelled video; evaluates video synthesis and action semantics.

note.zh: WHAM/Muse 生成、延续和编辑 Bleeding Edge 片段；一致性、多样性、编辑持久性不是玩家通关指标。
note.en: WHAM/Muse generates, continues and edits Bleeding Edge sequences; consistency, diversity and edit persistence are not player completion metrics.

note.zh: 将人类游戏目标写成奖励程序并生成新目标，使用人类评价衡量有趣性/人类相似性；不评估执行目标的 Agent。
note.en: Represents human goals as reward programs and generates new goals, assessed for fun and human-likeness; does not evaluate agents executing those goals.

note.zh: 编码 Agent 维护世界状态并驱动视频渲染；评价规则一致性和视觉实现，不将世界模拟能力当成玩家能力。
note.en: A coding agent maintains world state and drives video rendering; rule consistency and visual realization are not player capability.

note.zh: 控制的是合成视频，没有原引擎游戏目标或在线 agent 通关协议；未展开全部数据游戏。
note.en: Controls generated video; no native-engine agent goal or completion protocol. Full game roster is not expanded.

note.zh: 未评价 Minecraft 原引擎中的 agent 任务成功；赛车仅定性扩展示例，未确认具体赛车游戏。
note.en: No native Minecraft agent task-success evaluation. Racing is qualitative, with no confirmed named racing title.

note.zh: VLM 是视频评委，不是被测游戏玩家；没有原游戏 goal-driven 在线任务。
note.en: VLM is a video judge, not the tested player. No native-game goal-driven online task.

note.zh: 世界模型记忆不是 agent 记忆测试；未核得可对应具体游戏的录像名单。
note.en: World-model memory is not agent-memory testing. No verified title roster for game-level attribution.

note.zh: 报告中的长时记忆是生成画面一致性；没有命名游戏的任务完成评价。
note.en: Long-horizon memory concerns generated visual consistency; no named-game task-completion evaluation.

note.zh: GRPO 是代码生成训练，不是 RL 游戏玩家；未报告生成模型的在线对局胜率。
note.en: GRPO trains code generation rather than RL gameplay; no online match win-rate evaluation is reported.

note.zh: VLM 只判定生成画面；未测试 FPS agent 的原生游戏胜负或击杀目标。
note.en: VLM judges generated visuals only; no native FPS agent win/loss or combat-goal evaluation.

note.zh: 评价开发代理修改项目的能力；Godot 是引擎，任务中出现 RTS/FPS 不代表对应游玩评测。官方复现要求 Godot 4.4.1；本文与网站最新榜单可能版本不同。
note.en: Evaluates project editing by coding agents; Godot is an engine and RTS/FPS examples are not gameplay evaluations. Official validation requires Godot 4.4.1; paper and live leaderboard versions differ.

note.zh: 评价生成游戏产物，不是独立玩家代理的通关能力；家族名称不能直接变成商业游戏关联。
note.en: Scores generated artifacts rather than a standalone player agent; genre families do not imply named commercial-game links.

note.zh: UE5 是引擎；评估代码变更，不是 FPS/RTS 游玩。论文指向 Nitrode-Research/GameEngineBench，但本轮无法取回仓库页，未把链接当作已核验公开代码。
note.en: UE5 is an engine; evaluates code changes, not FPS/RTS play. The paper points to Nitrode-Research/GameEngineBench, but its page could not be retrieved in this pass, so code availability is unconfirmed.

note.zh: 训练集与 300 项评测集需分开；运行行为验证针对生成代码。完整子项目归属未在本轮逐项展开。
note.en: Training and the 300-project evaluation split are distinct; runtime verification evaluates generated code. Individual project/game membership was not fully expanded in this pass.

note.zh: 验收生成应用，不评价玩家模型；可用率不代表完整需求满足。部分项目形似 UNO/俄罗斯方块，不等于评测原版游戏。
note.en: Evaluates delivered applications rather than player models; usability does not equal full specification satisfaction. UNO/Tetris-like artifacts do not imply original-game evaluations.

note.zh: 浏览器执行/VLM judging 用于验收开发产物；不加入玩家能力覆盖。模型训练包含执行奖励 RL，不表示新增 RL 游玩任务。
note.en: Browser execution/VLM judging evaluates development artifacts, not player capability coverage. Execution-reward RL trains the coding model, not a new RL gameplay task.

note.zh: 分步浏览器 playtester 和独立 judge 检验产物；不能据此认定生成器具有玩家规划/控制能力。
note.en: A step-driven browser playtester and independent judge inspect artifacts; this does not establish the generator as a capable game-playing planner/controller.

note.zh: GUI playtester 提供修复反馈，最终得分仍衡量生成游戏质量；不自动计为通用玩家 benchmark。
note.en: The GUI playtester supplies repair feedback; final scores measure generated-game quality rather than a general player benchmark.

note.zh: 报告为系统与案例分析；未确认统一独立玩家测试集，不从创意案例推断稳定能力提升。
note.en: A system/case-study report; a unified independent player test set is not established, and creative examples do not establish stable capability gains.

note.zh: RFT/SFT 的动作预测准确率是离线指标，不等于完整导航成功率；不测生存、制作或通关。部分数据表 Base/Extend 标记与正文存在差异，使用具体表行和版本。
note.en: RFT/SFT action-prediction accuracy is offline, not complete-navigation success; survival/crafting/completion are excluded. Some Base/Extend table labels differ from prose; preserve table/version context.

note.zh: 评估生成世界模型；已给动作脚本，不测试 agent 选行动、协商或真实生存能力。十项模型指标不进入玩家能力覆盖。
note.en: Evaluates generated world models under supplied action scripts, not agent action choice, negotiation or survival; model metrics do not enter player-capability coverage.

note.zh: RL动作编辑关卡而非控制Minecraft玩家，不计游玩在线任务或玩家控制能力。
note.en: RL actions edit levels rather than control a Minecraft player; excluded from gameplay online tasks and player-control coverage.

note.zh: 评价关卡生成而非推箱子Agent；最终出版全文未在本轮取得，方法细节以可公开核对内容为限。
note.en: Evaluates level generation rather than a Sokoban-playing agent; the final published full text was not obtained in this pass.

note.zh: 剑盾是动画角色设定，不是具体商业格斗游戏；不计游戏游玩覆盖。仓库已提示弃用并指向MimicKit。
note.en: Sword/shield is an animation character configuration, not a named fighting game; outside gameplay coverage. The repository is deprecated in favor of MimicKit.

note.zh: 角色动画并非具体游戏游玩；当前公开SMPL检查点明确不支持文本控制，不能把论文所有模态当作现成可运行功能。
note.en: Character animation is not a specific game-playing task. The current public SMPL checkpoint explicitly lacks text control; paper modalities are not all shipped features.

note.zh: 足球运球是动作合成演示，未确认足球游戏规则、对手或比赛协议，不能映射为体育游戏benchmark。
note.en: Soccer dribbling is a motion-synthesis demonstration without a verified football-game match protocol, opponent or scoring system.

note.zh: 论文描述实时角色动画创作；未确认具体游戏环境或官方独立代码发布，不计在线游戏任务。
note.en: The paper concerns real-time animation authoring; no specific gameplay environment or official standalone code release was confirmed.

note.zh: 是动画任务规划与控制；并非有规则和对手的游戏benchmark，不把运动规划直接加入游戏Agent覆盖。
note.en: Animation planning/control, not a game benchmark with rules and opponents; motion planning does not automatically enter game-agent coverage.

note.zh: 主要方法使用解析物理梯度而非RL；不能因比较RL基线就标为RL算法。没有具体游戏游玩评测。
note.en: The main method uses analytic physics gradients rather than RL; RL baselines do not make it an RL method. No named gameplay evaluation.

note.zh: 虚拟角色控制而非具体游戏玩家控制；视频/文本来源不使该策略成为VLM或LLM。
note.en: Virtual-avatar control, not player control in a specific game; video/text motion sources do not make the policy an LLM or VLM.

detail.zh: 原文 §6 的指标为完整随机 playout/秒，未给候选 Agent 的胜率、回报或解题成功率。
detail.en: Section 6 measures complete random playouts/second, not candidate-agent win rate, return or solving success.

detail.zh: 尚缺与棋力指标配套的具体 Agent、对手、对局数量及座位控制；已有引擎动作 API 不足以替代。
detail.en: A concrete candidate/opponent matchup, game count and seat control linked to playing-strength metrics remains missing; engine action APIs do not supply it.

note.zh: 阅读全文后确认现有量化实验是引擎吞吐量比较。虽有规则、合法动作与完整随机对局，本轮未找到对应 Agent 表现评测，不将每秒 playout 数画成能力覆盖。
note.en: Full text confirms that its quantitative experiment compares engine throughput. Rules, legal actions and complete random playouts exist, but no corresponding agent-performance evaluation was found; playouts/second are not capability coverage.

note.zh: Generative Agents 是 Smallville 社交模拟代理架构，访谈可信度与涌现行为不是本网站的游戏胜率。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: Generative Agents is a Smallville simulation architecture; believability interviews and emergent behavior are not gameplay win scores. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: 动作模仿与虚拟角色运动控制方法；当前归属未提供具体游戏目标评测，不计入游戏能力图。
note.en: Motion imitation and virtual-character control method; the current attribution lacks a specific gameplay-goal protocol and is excluded from gameplay coverage.

note.zh: AAAI 全文核实 100 次会话形成 2550 指令—动作样本，主要指标为指令准确率、实体 P/R/F1、QPS 和延迟；24 名玩家比较四模式的主观偏好。不能把偏好分或样本纠错准确率当闭环胜率，暂不新增九维操控单位。
note.en: The AAAI paper specifies 2,550 instruction-action examples from 100 sessions, instruction/entity accuracy, QPS and latency, plus subjective preferences from 24 players across four modes. These are not closed-loop win rates.

note.zh: 256 名人类玩家的多模态生理与行为数据集；不将人类记录当成模型游戏任务表现。
note.en: Multimodal physiological/behavioural data from 256 human players; human recordings are not model gameplay evaluations.

note.zh: 比较 AI Director 的任务分配对人类体验的影响；不是玩家 Agent 的任务执行基准。
note.en: Compares effects of AI-director quest selection on human experience, not player-agent execution.

note.zh: 优化匹配公平性与参与度的配对系统；不评价局内操控。
note.en: Optimizes matchmaking fairness and engagement, not in-game control.

note.zh: 从游戏视频预测人类情感并与自评/传感器对照；不评价游戏策略。
note.en: Predicts human affect from gameplay video against self-report/sensors, not gameplay policies.

note.zh: 结合 EEG 与行为信息辅助人类识别目标；收敛与人类表现指标属于人机辅助研究。
note.en: Combines EEG and behavioural signals to assist human target detection; convergence and human performance measure assistive interaction.

note.zh: 这是人类认知研究；推断的人类规划深度不直接构成Agent规划benchmark。仓库及完整移动数据开放性未在本轮确认。
note.en: A human cognition study, not an autonomous-agent planning benchmark. A current official repository and full mobile-data availability were not confirmed in this pass.

note.zh: Agent扮演网络规划器而非普通合作/背叛玩家。OSF开放数据与分析脚本，不等同完整训练/部署平台。
note.en: The agent is a network planner, not a cooperate/defect player. OSF data and analysis scripts do not establish a full released training/deployment platform.

note.zh: 是机制设计者的评测，不是普通玩家的自主游戏控制；公开仓库主要提供人类数据和图表复现。
note.en: Evaluates a mechanism designer rather than autonomous gameplay as a participant; the released repository primarily supports human-data analysis and figure reproduction.

note.zh: 主分析限每局前60手，是历史观察性分析而非新Agent在线对弈benchmark。
note.en: The main analysis uses the first 60 moves and is historical observational research, not a new online agent-playing benchmark.

note.zh: Peak原始行为数据按协议不公开；模型拟合和网络可向作者申请；没有将此分析当作Agent规划能力证据。
note.en: Peak behavioral data are not public under the agreement; trained networks and fits are request-only. This analysis is not evidence of autonomous-agent planning capability.

detail.zh: 缺少某个具体游戏/成就的可核对任务机制及其与11轴的对应依据；已有总奖励和伦理指标不能替代。
detail.en: A concrete game/achievement mechanism and traceable mapping to an eleven-axis construct are still needed; aggregate rewards and ethics metrics are insufficient.

note.zh: 保留30款测试游戏的叙事选择、成就与伤害协议。当前论文的伦理伤害、权力指标和当前场景提示，不足以将某个具体游戏映射到11条能力轴；不把伦理评价当社会推理。
note.en: Preserved narrative choice, achievement and harm evaluation for thirty test games. Ethical-harm/power metrics and current-scene prompts do not establish a specific game’s eleven-axis capability; ethics is not treated as social inference.

note.zh: 合作 MARL 的统计评估方法研究，比较既有实验的可靠性；不是新增游戏任务。
note.en: Studies statistical methodology for cooperative MARL evaluation; it does not introduce new gameplay tasks.

note.zh: rliable 是统计分析方法：区间估计、IQM、性能分布等；使用 Atari/Procgen/DMC 的结果不构成新的游戏任务。
note.en: rliable supplies statistical analysis such as intervals, IQM and performance profiles; reuse of Atari/Procgen/DMC results is not a new gameplay task.

note.zh: 程序化内容生成综述；无独立游戏行动协议或可运行评测任务。
note.en: A procedural-content-generation survey, without an independent gameplay protocol or runnable evaluation task.

note.zh: 游戏作弊与反作弊系统综述；不包含独立的游戏 Agent 任务组合。
note.en: A systematization of cheating and anti-cheat research, without an independent game-agent task suite.

note.zh: 综述中提到的游戏和编辑器不是本文实际评测游戏，不展开为在线任务。
note.en: Mentioned games and editors are survey examples, not evaluated gameplay tasks.

note.zh: 核验HAWK为CS:GO服务端作弊识别，使用多视角行为特征判断作弊类型与程度；属于反作弊检测，不是Agent游戏操控评测。
note.en: HAWK detects cheating in CS:GO using server-side multi-view behavior features; it evaluates detection, not agent gameplay control.

note.zh: 服务器端辅助瞄准作弊检测；检测精度和开销属于安全评测。
note.en: Server-side aim-assist cheat detection; detection quality and overhead are security evaluation.

note.zh: 从 CS2 数据窗口检测作弊，准确率与 AUC 评价分类，不是游戏策略。
note.en: Classifies cheating in CS2 data windows; accuracy and AUC measure detection, not game policies.

note.zh: 视觉扰动防御瞄准外挂；评估防御效果和视觉质量，不是玩家能力。
note.en: Visual perturbations defend against aimbots; evaluation concerns defence and visual quality, not player capability.

note.zh: 客户端外挂检测的准确率与运行开销评价；不计入游戏能力覆盖。
note.en: Evaluates client-side aimbot detection accuracy and runtime overhead; excluded from gameplay capability coverage.

note.zh: GAN 辅助瞄准的安全威胁研究，评价性能影响与可检测性；不作为合法游戏 Agent 基准。
note.en: Studies GAN-assisted aiming as a security threat, evaluating performance effects and detectability; not a general game-agent benchmark.

note.zh: 身份/账号一致性识别，既不控制游戏，也不按这些特征评价 agent 的 FPS 水平。
note.en: Identity/account consistency recognition; does not control gameplay or evaluate agent FPS proficiency.

note.zh: 对应Overwatch而非Overwatch 2；人类语音数据不代表Agent操控或多Agent协作benchmark。
note.en: Original Overwatch, not Overwatch 2; human speech data do not establish an agent-control or multi-agent-cooperation benchmark.

note.zh: 动作是深度传感器/相机导航；不在 ViZDoom 中打敌人，不测瞄准、射击或 FPS 战绩。
note.en: Actions move a depth-sensor/camera; this is not ViZDoom combat and does not test aiming, shooting or FPS match performance.

note.zh: 评测产物的物理设计与控制，不是LLM逐帧直接玩商业游戏或现实机器人能力；独立节点，仅相关研究，不计游戏Arena在线覆盖。
note.en: Evaluates physical-design/control artifacts, not frame-by-frame LLM play in a commercial game or real-world robotics. Kept as a distinct adjacent node outside gameplay Arena coverage.

note.zh: 方法论文有真实对局与分难度胜率，可接入文献任务；地图、种子和调用预算未完全标准化。
note.en: This method paper includes real games and difficulty-specific win rates; maps, seeds and API budgets are not fully standardized.

note.zh: 补入原始 SMAC 协作微操协议，能力范围限定为单位协作和控制。
note.en: Registered original SMAC cooperative micromanagement, scoped to unit coordination and control.

note.zh: 从平台的实际小游戏评估中接入 BuildMarines；没有把人类回放预测作为游玩任务。
note.en: Registered BuildMarines from the platform’s interactive mini-game evaluation, excluding replay prediction.

note.zh: 确认 COPA 的修改版 SMAC 实际对局及胜率，限定为团队微操，不向资源采集或救援节点复制该协议。
note.en: Confirmed COPA modified-SMAC matches and win rates, scoped to team micromanagement without copying the protocol to collection/rescue nodes.

note.zh: 方法论文包含完整闭环比赛，已补入可明确定位的 TvT 人类评测；保留小样本边界。
note.en: The method paper includes full closed-loop games; added the precisely scoped TvT human evaluation with its small-sample limitation.

note.zh: 全文 §4 明确 MPE/SMACv1/MAMuJoCo 分别训练 50k/100k/200k 次更新，训练结束评估 32 局、重复 10 种子。已补进离线 SMAC 单位；禁止把在线挑选最佳 checkpoint 的预算隐去。
note.en: Section 4 uses 50k/100k/200k updates for MPE/SMACv1/MAMuJoCo, then 32 evaluation episodes across ten seeds. Added SMAC controls; online checkpoint-selection budget must not be hidden.

note.zh: 合作 MARL 的统计评估方法研究，比较既有实验的可靠性；不是新增游戏任务。
note.en: Studies statistical methodology for cooperative MARL evaluation; it does not introduce new gameplay tasks.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: 全文比较的算法交互预算按在/离策略和环境区分，评估 41 次各 100 局；这些设定仅用于既有 LBF/RWARE 单位。SMAC/MPE/矩阵游戏需各自明确任务和指标，暂不继承该协议。
note.en: The paper separates training budgets by on/off-policy algorithms and environment, with 41 evaluations of 100 episodes. These controls apply to the retained LBF/RWARE units; SMAC/MPE/matrix games require their own protocols.

note.zh: 全文4.1与附录E补SCII五类宏动作、10局/场景和RPM等公式，并新增既有StarCraft II游戏关联；本次未将六环境五维标签整体摊到每个子游戏。
note.en: Section4.1 and appendixE specify SCII macro actions, ten matches/scenario and RPM-related formulas, with an existing StarCraft II association; suite-wide labels are not spread across all six games.

note.zh: 补入 ELF 实际 Mini-RTS 完整对局实验，并说明宏动作及信息不对称。
note.en: Registered ELF’s actual full-game Mini-RTS experiments with explicit macro-action and information-asymmetry limits.

note.zh: 全文任务表与评测节确认五诊断小游戏的独立指标。当前核验范围明确限定这五类；完整比赛与生成游戏质量评分不混入这些任务。
note.en: Full-text task tables and evaluation verify the five diagnostic minigames and their metrics. Scope is explicitly limited to these; full matches and game-generation quality remain separate.

note.zh: 作者 PDF 补齐全局 RTS 对局协议；明确本论文使用单地图、完全可观测设置，不能外推地图泛化或部分可观测记忆。
note.en: Author PDF resolves full RTS play on a single map under full observability; no map-generalization or partial-observation memory claim is added.

note.zh: 47 项浏览器游戏生成任务；L1/L2 检查通过率与严格任务成功率评价软件实现。
note.en: Forty-seven browser-game generation tasks; L1/L2 pass rates and strict success assess software implementation.

note.zh: Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，评价程序行为正确性；角色动作属于被测程序输出，不是被评估模型的游戏策略。
note.en: Godot logic implementation and repair evaluates program behaviour; character actions are outputs of the implemented software, not the evaluated model’s gameplay policy.

note.zh: 截图与视频 QA：视觉单元/回归测试、异常检测和报告生成；没有游戏行动闭环。
note.en: Image/video QA covers visual unit/regression tests, glitches and reports; there is no gameplay action loop.

note.zh: 全文补清 SMAX、MPE、MABrax 与原环境等价性边界：MPE 用 1000 随机轨迹逐状态比对，Hanabi 用 10000 轨迹；MABrax 与 MAMuJoCo 不可直接比分。保留 SMAX 微操协议，速度基准不新增能力标签。
note.en: The full paper checks MPE with 1,000 random rollouts and Hanabi with 10,000 trajectories; MABrax is not directly score-comparable to MAMuJoCo. Retain SMAX micromanagement; throughput benchmarks add no capability tags.

note.zh: 合作 MARL 的统计评估方法研究，比较既有实验的可靠性；不是新增游戏任务。
note.en: Studies statistical methodology for cooperative MARL evaluation; it does not introduce new gameplay tasks.

note.zh: 竞技对战和 RPG 速通拆为两个游戏专属任务，分别记录指标与 harness 边界。
note.en: Split competitive battles and RPG speedrunning into game-specific units with separate metrics and harness limits.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。

note.en: Raw frames, timed actions and checkpoint scoring are confirmed; other public games and the hidden set do not inherit these tags.

detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: 全文表1与附录D.3定位2048独立协议、1000步上限和归一化合并分；明确游戏内时间约束与反思条件。其余14游戏不在本次能力单元范围。
note.en: Table 1 and appendix D.3 establish the 2048 protocol, 1000-step cap and normalized merge score, with time and reflection conditions explicit; other games are outside this unit.

note.zh: 论文协议和指标已核验；未运行复现。
note.en: Paper protocols and metrics verified; not reproduced.

note.zh: 从 §5 的实际比赛补入语言谈判与军令协议，并按显式 18/34 中心阈值处理正文笔误。
note.en: Added Section 5 match protocols for negotiation and military orders, resolving prose errors using the explicit 18/34-center threshold.

note.zh: 有交流 Diplomacy 的私聊、同时指令和补给中心计分已纳入；范围限定于原论文人类 blitz 联赛。
note.en: Integrated private dialogue, simultaneous orders and supply-centre scoring in full-press Diplomacy, limited to the paper’s human blitz league.

note.zh: Welfare Diplomacy 改写奖励为福利，是非零和规则变体，不应与原版 Diplomacy 胜率混合。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: Welfare Diplomacy changes rewards to welfare, a general-sum variant whose scores should not mix with standard Diplomacy wins. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: 论文协议和指标已核验；未运行复现。
note.en: Paper protocols and metrics verified; not reproduced.

note.zh: 全文实验证据主要为单位参数平衡：随机/半随机队伍的大规模模拟、成对胜负矩阵和不同平衡损失比较；55K games/s是引擎吞吐。未定位固定学习代理与独立评测任务的完整协议，保留环境/设计研究，不新增能力任务。
note.en: Full-text experiments primarily evaluate unit-parameter balancing through random/semi-random teams, win-loss matrices and balancing losses;55K games/s is throughput. A complete fixed learning-agent evaluation protocol was not located, so no capability unit is added.

note.zh: 仅展开一个有明确收益、代价、输入和动作协议的安全 RL 场景。
note.en: Expands one safe-RL scenario with explicit reward, cost, inputs and actions.

note.zh: 使用官方跨域序列及持续学习指标；遗忘指模型学习保留，不等同回合内记忆能力。
note.en: Uses the documented sequence and continual-learning metrics; forgetting is learning retention, not within-episode memory.

note.zh: 原文给出输入、动作、指标、留出等级和重复实验设置；四场景共享评测设计合并为一个单位。
note.en: The paper specifies inputs, actions, metrics, holdout levels and repeats; shared evaluation across four scenarios forms one unit.

note.zh: 核验Minecraft MCU闭环成功率/交互步数及四地图ViZDoom平均回报；不把世界模型预测质量当作游戏成绩。
note.en: Verified MCU closed-loop success/action counts and four-map ViZDoom episode rewards; prediction quality is not gameplay performance.

note.zh: 重新核对控制实验与世界模型诊断的区分：Atari100k、Crafter、五个 ViZDoom 场景为闭环回报，MiniGrid 的预测一致性实验不计记忆操控能力。既有任务范围保持，训练曲线不是逐模型统一试玩协议。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
note.en: Rechecked control versus world-model diagnostics: Atari100k, Crafter and five ViZDoom scenarios measure closed-loop returns, whereas MiniGrid prediction consistency is not memory-control performance. Retain those bounded units; learning curves are not a uniform model-play protocol. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

note.zh: DOOM 神经模拟器，评价画面预测、交互帧率与稳定性；采集数据的 RL 策略不是本文独立能力基准。
note.en: A DOOM neural simulator evaluates visual prediction, interactive frame rate and stability; its data-collection policy is not a separate capability benchmark.

note.zh: 从潜变量生成三维场景与新视角；评价场景生成质量，不是游戏决策。
note.en: Generates 3D scenes and novel views from latent variables; evaluates scene quality, not game decisions.

note.zh: 生成可漫游三维场景的辐射场模型；没有 Agent 在游戏中选择动作完成目标的评测。
note.en: Generates navigable radiance-field scenes; no agent gameplay goal-completion evaluation is specified.

note.zh: 局部辐射场场景生成与补全；自由相机是渲染条件，不是游戏策略。
note.en: Scene generation and completion with local radiance fields; camera movement conditions rendering rather than a gameplay policy.

note.zh: GAN 辅助瞄准的安全威胁研究，评价性能影响与可检测性；不作为合法游戏 Agent 基准。
note.en: Studies GAN-assisted aiming as a security threat, evaluating performance effects and detectability; not a general game-agent benchmark.

detail.zh: My Way Home等其余场景的具体代码动作绑定尚未完成；已知完成时间不替代该绑定。
detail.en: Code-level action bindings remain for My Way Home and other scenarios; known completion times do not replace them.

note.zh: 本地作者全文和官方训练命令共同确认Basic AI任务、左右移动/射击、视听条件与5亿步回报比较，已纳入；人类击杀率不参与该单元。
note.en: The local author full text and official commands verify Basic AI actions, audiovisual conditions and 500-million-step return evaluation; human kill rates are excluded.

note.zh: 仅一个场景；模型接收不同编码的等价 ASCII/深度信息，未给 LLM 原始视觉；回合数 3/5/10 不同，总击杀不能直接作等预算排名。训练为人类示范监督学习。
note.en: One scenario; LLMs receive text ASCII/depth rather than raw vision. Episode counts differ (3/5/10), so cumulative frags are not equal-budget rankings. The small model uses supervised human demonstrations.

note.zh: 动作是深度传感器/相机导航；不在 ViZDoom 中打敌人，不测瞄准、射击或 FPS 战绩。
note.en: Actions move a depth-sensor/camera; this is not ViZDoom combat and does not test aiming, shooting or FPS match performance.

note.zh: 原始帧、定时按键和检查点评分已确认；其他公测游戏与隐藏集不继承此任务标签。
note.en: Raw frames, timed actions and checkpoint scoring are confirmed; other public games and the hidden set do not inherit these tags.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: 全文§3.5/§4.1确认状态验证器、100动作预算及推理时暂停。保留已核实的Minecraft克隆采集和Flappy Bird两单位，不把其能力推广至其余32游戏。
note.en: Sections 3.5/4.1 verify state-based scoring, a 100-action budget, and paused inference. Retain the Minecraft-clone collection and Flappy Bird units only; do not propagate capabilities to 32 other games.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: 核实25个公开ARC-AGI-3游戏的互动规则发现、动作接口和RHAE；只将明确共有的未知规则探索归类，不为各游戏复制其他能力标签。
note.en: Verified interactive rule discovery, action interface and RHAE on twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games; only the explicitly shared unknown-rule exploration mechanism is mapped.

detail.zh: 在线 Minecraft 的具体可执行动作格式与执行器尚未公开定位；项目仓库仍把在线环境列为发布计划，论文键绑定表属于数据注释，不能替代在线接口。
detail.en: The executable online Minecraft action format and executor remain unlocated. The repository lists online environments in its release roadmap; annotation keybindings do not establish the online interface.

note.zh: 在线 Minecraft 的具体可执行动作格式与执行器尚未公开定位；项目仓库仍把在线环境列为发布计划，论文键绑定表属于数据注释，不能替代在线接口。
note.en: The executable online Minecraft action format and executor remain unlocated. The repository lists online environments in its release roadmap; annotation keybindings do not establish the online interface.

note.zh: 全文补齐三款游戏的完整流程分数与视觉—执行接口。记录的是 GameSense 系统闭环任务，不把模块控制归因于裸 VLM。
note.en: Full text supplies complete-flow scores and visual/execution interfaces for three games. These are closed-loop GameSense system tasks, not isolated VLM control.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: Crossroads 已确认移动/转向、团队全员到达奖励及种群排名；只将该竞赛协议纳入，不复制到平台其余游戏。
note.en: Crossroads has verified move/turn actions, team-arrival rewards and population rankings; only that race protocol is integrated.

note.zh: ChronoPlay 是游戏知识 RAG 问答与内容时效 benchmark，不属于游戏控制能力覆盖。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: ChronoPlay benchmarks game-domain RAG and information freshness, not gameplay control capabilities. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: GameGen、GameFix、GameOpt 三条开发轨道，评价生成质量、缺陷修复和跨轮优化保真度；不映射到玩家能力。
note.en: GameGen, GameFix and GameOpt assess creation, repair and iterative optimization fidelity, not player capabilities.

note.zh: 截图与视频 QA：视觉单元/回归测试、异常检测和报告生成；没有游戏行动闭环。
note.en: Image/video QA covers visual unit/regression tests, glitches and reports; there is no gameplay action loop.

note.zh: 评测世界模型在长 rollout 后重现历史画面的能力；属于生成时序一致性，不是玩家记忆。
note.en: Tests reconstruction of past visual context after long world-model rollouts; temporal generation consistency is not player memory.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。

note.zh: 完整论文区分 Atari100k 策略评估与 CS:GO 交互生成演示。前者以真实交互预算、逐游戏回报/人类归一化分评价；后者没有可替代原游戏对战胜率的评测，继续只保留 Atari 单位。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
note.en: The full paper separates Atari100k policy evaluation from interactive CS:GO generation. Real-interaction budgets and game/human-normalized returns apply to Atari; CS:GO generation does not supply native-match wins. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

note.zh: 256 名人类玩家的多模态生理与行为数据集；不将人类记录当成模型游戏任务表现。
note.en: Multimodal physiological/behavioural data from 256 human players; human recordings are not model gameplay evaluations.

note.zh: 核验HAWK为CS:GO服务端作弊识别，使用多视角行为特征判断作弊类型与程度；属于反作弊检测，不是Agent游戏操控评测。
note.en: HAWK detects cheating in CS:GO using server-side multi-view behavior features; it evaluates detection, not agent gameplay control.

note.zh: 服务器端辅助瞄准作弊检测；检测精度和开销属于安全评测。
note.en: Server-side aim-assist cheat detection; detection quality and overhead are security evaluation.

note.zh: 客户端外挂检测的准确率与运行开销评价；不计入游戏能力覆盖。
note.en: Evaluates client-side aimbot detection accuracy and runtime overhead; excluded from gameplay capability coverage.

note.zh: MAP-Elites 生成 FPS 地图，以拓扑与玩法诱发特征评价质量和多样性，目标是内容生成。
note.en: MAP-Elites generates FPS maps and evaluates topology, gameplay-induced features, quality and diversity; this is content generation.

note.zh: AAAI 全文核实 100 次会话形成 2550 指令—动作样本，主要指标为指令准确率、实体 P/R/F1、QPS 和延迟；24 名玩家比较四模式的主观偏好。不能把偏好分或样本纠错准确率当闭环胜率，暂不新增九维操控单位。
note.en: The AAAI paper specifies 2,550 instruction-action examples from 100 sessions, instruction/entity accuracy, QPS and latency, plus subjective preferences from 24 players across four modes. These are not closed-loop win rates.

note.zh: 同步第一视角视频上的队友/对手位置预测；感知预测结果不能直接代表闭环多 Agent 协作。
note.en: Predicts teammate/opponent positions from synchronized egocentric footage; perception results do not establish closed-loop multi-agent coordination.

note.zh: 从 CS2 数据窗口检测作弊，准确率与 AUC 评价分类，不是游戏策略。
note.en: Classifies cheating in CS2 data windows; accuracy and AUC measure detection, not game policies.

note.zh: 视觉扰动防御瞄准外挂；评估防御效果和视觉质量，不是玩家能力。
note.en: Visual perturbations defend against aimbots; evaluation concerns defence and visual quality, not player capability.

note.zh: 本地及作者官网全文确认研究实时超分辨率；CS2、OW2、TF2 是画质素材/系统测试场景。指标不是 Agent 游戏表现，保留游戏关联但不计覆盖图。
note.en: Local and author-hosted full text confirms real-time super-resolution. CS2, OW2 and TF2 provide content/system scenarios, not agent-performance tasks; game links remain outside capability coverage.

note.zh: 身份/账号一致性识别，既不控制游戏，也不按这些特征评价 agent 的 FPS 水平。
note.en: Identity/account consistency recognition; does not control gameplay or evaluate agent FPS proficiency.

note.zh: 结合 EEG 与行为信息辅助人类识别目标；收敛与人类表现指标属于人机辅助研究。
note.en: Combines EEG and behavioural signals to assist human target detection; convergence and human performance measure assistive interaction.

note.zh: 对应Overwatch而非Overwatch 2；人类语音数据不代表Agent操控或多Agent协作benchmark。
note.en: Original Overwatch, not Overwatch 2; human speech data do not establish an agent-control or multi-agent-cooperation benchmark.

note.en: The AAAI paper specifies 2,550 instruction-action examples from 100 sessions, instruction/entity accuracy, QPS and latency, plus subjective preferences from 24 players across four modes. These are not closed-loop win rates.

note.zh: 全文3.3、4.3与表3核验46款而非ALE全部57款，9/37策略选择划分和最佳数据策略归一化；只登记Atari部分。 本轮归属复核：依据官方配置的实际数组关联46款：9款在线选参、37款离线选择评测。配置中的旧注释写45/36，与数组数量不符，因此以数组和论文为准。
note.en: Sections 3.3/4.3 and table 3 verify 46 games rather than all 57 ALE titles, the 9/37 selection split and best-data-policy normalization; Atari only. Routing review: Route forty-six explicit configuration entries: nine tuning and thirty-seven evaluation games. Stale 45/36 comments disagree with the executable lists and paper.

note.zh: 重新核对控制实验与世界模型诊断的区分：Atari100k、Crafter、五个 ViZDoom 场景为闭环回报，MiniGrid 的预测一致性实验不计记忆操控能力。既有任务范围保持，训练曲线不是逐模型统一试玩协议。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
note.en: Rechecked control versus world-model diagnostics: Atari100k, Crafter and five ViZDoom scenarios measure closed-loop returns, whereas MiniGrid prediction consistency is not memory-control performance. Retain those bounded units; learning curves are not a uniform model-play protocol. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

note.zh: 完整论文区分 Atari100k 策略评估与 CS:GO 交互生成演示。前者以真实交互预算、逐游戏回报/人类归一化分评价；后者没有可替代原游戏对战胜率的评测，继续只保留 Atari 单位。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
note.en: The full paper separates Atari100k policy evaluation from interactive CS:GO generation. Real-interaction budgets and game/human-normalized returns apply to Atari; CS:GO generation does not supply native-match wins. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

note.en: Full text confirms DSLE-5 is a five-boss subset, separate from the 22-boss extension. Identical saves and actions can diverge because game-internal randomness is unseeded; deterministic replay is not guaranteed.

note.zh: 全文Task Design与Implementation Details确认114任务、360步、四视角和5次试验；明确测试时同任务配置优化，避免误标跨游戏泛化。
note.en: Task Design and Implementation Details confirm 114 tasks, 360-step budgets, four views and five trials; adaptation is within the same task, not cross-game generalization.

note.zh: DungeonBench 是 D&D 2014 风格规则模拟器，分单场 Encounter 与资源跨场持续的 Day 轨道。 已核对下列协议；覆盖范围限所列任务与设置。
note.en: DungeonBench is a D&D-2014-style simulator with single Encounter and persistent-resource Day tracks. Protocols below are verified only for their stated tasks and conditions.

note.zh: ChronoPlay 是游戏知识 RAG 问答与内容时效 benchmark，不属于游戏控制能力覆盖。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: ChronoPlay benchmarks game-domain RAG and information freshness, not gameplay control capabilities. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，评价程序行为正确性；角色动作属于被测程序输出，不是被评估模型的游戏策略。
note.en: Godot logic implementation and repair evaluates program behaviour; character actions are outputs of the implemented software, not the evaluated model’s gameplay policy.

note.zh: LLM 扮演 RPG 引擎：创建世界并模拟状态更新；规则一致性和内容质量评测不等同于玩家规划或社交。
note.en: LLMs act as RPG engines, creating worlds and simulating state updates; mechanics and content quality do not directly assess player planning or social skill.

note.zh: 截图与视频 QA：视觉单元/回归测试、异常检测和报告生成；没有游戏行动闭环。
note.en: Image/video QA covers visual unit/regression tests, glitches and reports; there is no gameplay action loop.

note.zh: 47 项浏览器游戏生成任务；L1/L2 检查通过率与严格任务成功率评价软件实现。
note.en: Forty-seven browser-game generation tasks; L1/L2 pass rates and strict success assess software implementation.

note.zh: Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，评价程序行为正确性；角色动作属于被测程序输出，不是被评估模型的游戏策略。
note.en: Godot logic implementation and repair evaluates program behaviour; character actions are outputs of the implemented software, not the evaluated model’s gameplay policy.

note.zh: 247 项 Godot/Unity 开发、修复与迁移任务；执行检查和视觉评分评价游戏产物。
note.en: 247 Godot/Unity construction, repair and porting tasks; runtime checks and visual rubrics evaluate produced games.

note.zh: 截图与视频 QA：视觉单元/回归测试、异常检测和报告生成；没有游戏行动闭环。
note.en: Image/video QA covers visual unit/regression tests, glitches and reports; there is no gameplay action loop.

note.zh: 按语言交互生成动漫状态和动画片段；评价生成一致性和体验，不是固定规则下的玩家策略。
note.en: Generates anime states and animation clips from language interaction; evaluates generation consistency and experience, not player policies under fixed rules.

note.zh: 评测产物的物理设计与控制，不是LLM逐帧直接玩商业游戏或现实机器人能力；独立节点，仅相关研究，不计游戏Arena在线覆盖。
note.en: Evaluates physical-design/control artifacts, not frame-by-frame LLM play in a commercial game or real-world robotics. Kept as a distinct adjacent node outside gameplay Arena coverage.

detail.zh: 其余游戏的能力需按各自目标另外判定。
detail.en: Other games require goal-specific capability review.

note.zh: 保留34款共同评测协议，新增仅限 Game Cafe Escape 的依赖规划视图；未向其余33款传播规划标签。
note.en: Preserved the 34-game protocol and added a Game Cafe Escape dependency-planning view; no planning label is propagated to the other games.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: Blind Bandits 的左右动作、私有历史和合作约定奖励已核实并纳入；Balance Beam 与人类 Overcooked 试验仍未在本次拆成独立协议。
note.en: Verified and integrated Blind Bandits actions, private histories and convention rewards; Balance Beam and human Overcooked studies are not separate protocols in this pass.

detail.zh: 真实人类实验条件尚未另建协议。
detail.en: Human-participant conditions are not separately encoded.

note.zh: 已纳入五布局上的未见伙伴交付评测；将协作和伙伴泛化区分，不混入真实人类试验。
note.en: Integrated held-out-partner delivery evaluation on five layouts, separating coordination and partner transfer from the human study.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: 附录与指标章节明确追捕/逃脱的成功率和回合数；原合并单位保留 ID 并细分为追捕，新增发电机逃脱单位，避免重复计数。198 道 CoordinationQA 仍不计交互能力。
note.en: The appendix specifies capture/escape success and turns. The original combined ID is retained for capture and escape is separated to avoid double counting; the 198 CoordinationQA questions remain outside interactive coverage.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: 原始帧、定时按键和检查点评分已确认；其他公测游戏与隐藏集不继承此任务标签。
note.en: Raw frames, timed actions and checkpoint scoring are confirmed; other public games and the hidden set do not inherit these tags.

note.zh: 已核验任务协议和指标；未复现。
note.en: Task protocols and metrics verified; not reproduced.

note.zh: rliable 是统计分析方法：区间估计、IQM、性能分布等；使用 Atari/Procgen/DMC 的结果不构成新的游戏任务。
note.en: rliable supplies statistical analysis such as intervals, IQM and performance profiles; reuse of Atari/Procgen/DMC results is not a new gameplay task.

note.zh: 再次核对 CORA 的任务序列与评价定义：Forward/Backward Transfer 衡量训练序列中的迁移和遗忘，不能当单局工作记忆。保留 Procgen/MiniHack 的已核验单位；Atari/CHORES 各子任务的完整配置尚未逐一转录。 本轮归属复核：仅关联CORA实际顺序训练的六款Procgen游戏，不拓展到Procgen全16款。
note.en: Rechecked CORA’s task sequences and metrics: forward/backward transfer concern transfer and forgetting across training, not within-episode working memory. Retain Procgen/MiniHack units; complete Atari/CHORES subtask configurations remain untranscribed. Routing review: Route only the six Procgen games actually trained sequentially in CORA, not all sixteen platform games.

note.zh: 本轮已核对限定任务的目标、观测/动作与原始指标并接入文献覆盖；保留 partial，具体配置和范围限制见各单元。未复现实验，不代表 Arena 已可运行。
note.en: This pass verifies bounded task goals, observations/actions and original metrics for literature coverage. Partial status retains the configuration and scope limits in each unit. No experiments were reproduced and Arena runtime availability is not implied.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: 全文表1与附录D.3定位2048独立协议、1000步上限和归一化合并分；明确游戏内时间约束与反思条件。其余14游戏不在本次能力单元范围。
note.en: Table 1 and appendix D.3 establish the 2048 protocol, 1000-step cap and normalized merge score, with time and reflection conditions explicit; other games are outside this unit.

detail.zh: 在线 Minecraft 的具体可执行动作格式与执行器尚未公开定位；项目仓库仍把在线环境列为发布计划，论文键绑定表属于数据注释，不能替代在线接口。
detail.en: The executable online Minecraft action format and executor remain unlocated. The repository lists online environments in its release roadmap; annotation keybindings do not establish the online interface.

note.zh: 在线 Minecraft 的具体可执行动作格式与执行器尚未公开定位；项目仓库仍把在线环境列为发布计划，论文键绑定表属于数据注释，不能替代在线接口。
note.en: The executable online Minecraft action format and executor remain unlocated. The repository lists online environments in its release roadmap; annotation keybindings do not establish the online interface.

note.zh: 控制的是合成视频，没有原引擎游戏目标或在线 agent 通关协议；未展开全部数据游戏。
note.en: Controls generated video; no native-engine agent goal or completion protocol. Full game roster is not expanded.

note.zh: 本轮按统一标准接入有明确观测、动作与指标的限定任务；仍缺的配置写入 limits。文献协议已核验、未复现，不表示 Arena 可运行。
note.en: This pass includes a bounded task with explicit observations, actions and metrics; remaining configuration gaps are recorded in limits. Literature reviewed, not reproduced and not an Arena runnable claim.

note.zh: 全文§3.5/§4.1确认状态验证器、100动作预算及推理时暂停。保留已核实的Minecraft克隆采集和Flappy Bird两单位，不把其能力推广至其余32游戏。
note.en: Sections 3.5/4.1 verify state-based scoring, a 100-action budget, and paused inference. Retain the Minecraft-clone collection and Flappy Bird units only; do not propagate capabilities to 32 other games.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: 核实25个公开ARC-AGI-3游戏的互动规则发现、动作接口和RHAE；只将明确共有的未知规则探索归类，不为各游戏复制其他能力标签。
note.en: Verified interactive rule discovery, action interface and RHAE on twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games; only the explicitly shared unknown-rule exploration mechanism is mapped.

note.zh: 全文补齐三款游戏的完整流程分数与视觉—执行接口。记录的是 GameSense 系统闭环任务，不把模块控制归因于裸 VLM。
note.en: Full text supplies complete-flow scores and visual/execution interfaces for three games. These are closed-loop GameSense system tasks, not isolated VLM control.

note.zh: 已按表 1 的 12 个具体游戏分别绑定任务和指标；不把雷达图全部维度继承给每款游戏。
note.en: Each of the 12 games is mapped to its own Table 1 task and metric; radar-chart dimensions are not copied to every game.

note.zh: GameQA 是从游戏生成的可验证视觉推理训练数据；跨域收益不能视为在 30 款游戏中实际游玩的能力覆盖。
note.en: GameQA is verifiable visual-reasoning training data generated from games; transfer gains do not establish interactive play coverage across the 30 source games.

note.zh: 编码 Agent 维护世界状态并驱动视频渲染；评价规则一致性和视觉实现，不将世界模拟能力当成玩家能力。
note.en: A coding agent maintains world state and drives video rendering; rule consistency and visual realization are not player capability.

note.zh: VLM 只判定生成画面；未测试 FPS agent 的原生游戏胜负或击杀目标。
note.en: VLM judges generated visuals only; no native FPS agent win/loss or combat-goal evaluation.

note.zh: 研究从视频预测键盘动作的逆动力学模型；作为方法研究保留，不将模型结构或方法收益直接记作独立基准覆盖。
note.en: Studies inverse-dynamics prediction of key presses from video; retained as method research, without turning architecture or method improvements into independent benchmark coverage.

note.zh: VLM 是视频评委，不是被测游戏玩家；没有原游戏 goal-driven 在线任务。
note.en: VLM is a video judge, not the tested player. No native-game goal-driven online task.

note.zh: 全文确认DSLE-5只是五首领代表子集，22首领扩展设置不混合。补充重要控制边界：相同存档和动作仍会因游戏内部随机性产生不同轨迹，不能称完全固定种子可重现。
note.en: Full text confirms DSLE-5 is a five-boss subset, separate from the 22-boss extension. Identical saves and actions can diverge because game-internal randomness is unseeded; deterministic replay is not guaranteed.

note.zh: 全文Task Design与Implementation Details确认114任务、360步、四视角和5次试验；明确测试时同任务配置优化，避免误标跨游戏泛化。
note.en: Task Design and Implementation Details confirm 114 tasks, 360-step budgets, four views and five trials; adaptation is within the same task, not cross-game generalization.

note.zh: 附录C.10补Atari改造：128维RAM、连续到离散动作与1000步回合；在线游戏与机器人泛化严格分开，当前子范围仅Ms. Pac-Man/Space Invaders。
note.en: AppendixC.10 specifies Atari adaptations:128-dimensional RAM, continuous-to-discrete actions and1000-step episodes. Game scope is Ms. Pac-Man/Space Invaders, excluding robot-transfer results.

note.zh: 100k 训练交互预算；想象内策略学习不等同于原游戏真实交互。
note.en: 100k training interactions; imagination training must be distinguished from real-emulator interaction.

note.zh: 100k 训练交互预算；想象内策略学习不等同于原游戏真实交互。
note.en: 100k training interactions; imagination training must be distinguished from real-emulator interaction.

note.zh: 100k 训练交互预算；想象内策略学习不等同于原游戏真实交互。
note.en: 100k training interactions; imagination training must be distinguished from real-emulator interaction.

note.zh: 有限前瞻、符号对象及检查点回滚；预测精度不等于更强通关，非整游戏评价。
note.en: Bounded lookahead, symbolic objects and checkpoint rollback; predictive fidelity is not equivalent to stronger full-game play.

note.zh: 全文5.3–5.4补50/10/5划分、冻结骨干、5万适应预算和不同归一化参照；能力限显式迁移评测。 本轮归属复核：附录B表1明确50个ID、10个Near-OOD、5个Far-OOD评测对象；这是表征冻结后的适配协议，游戏名称相同也须保留其分布角色。
note.en: Sections 5.3–5.4 establish 50/10/5 splits, frozen backbones, 50K adaptation budgets and different normalization references; capability is limited to explicit transfer evaluation. Routing review: Appendix B Table 1 identifies 50 ID, 10 near-OOD and 5 far-OOD evaluation targets; this is frozen-representation adaptation and split roles must be preserved.

note.zh: AAAI全文游戏分数表注确认500随机局、108K帧和采样设置；将静态注视/动作预测与真正在线游玩指标分离。 本轮归属复核：按图8的20款真实在线游戏分数关联，不将仅动作预测或注视数据当作在线评测。
note.en: The AAAI full-text score-table note specifies 500 random-seed episodes, 108K frames and sampling settings; static gaze/action prediction is separated from actual online gameplay. Routing review: Route the twenty games with actual online scores in Figure 8, separately from gaze/action prediction data.

note.zh: 全文3.3、4.3与表3核验46款而非ALE全部57款，9/37策略选择划分和最佳数据策略归一化；只登记Atari部分。 本轮归属复核：依据官方配置的实际数组关联46款：9款在线选参、37款离线选择评测。配置中的旧注释写45/36，与数组数量不符，因此以数组和论文为准。
note.en: Sections 3.3/4.3 and table 3 verify 46 games rather than all 57 ALE titles, the 9/37 selection split and best-data-policy normalization; Atari only. Routing review: Route forty-six explicit configuration entries: nine tuning and thirty-seven evaluation games. Stale 45/36 comments disagree with the executable lists and paper.

note.zh: 重新核对控制实验与世界模型诊断的区分：Atari100k、Crafter、五个 ViZDoom 场景为闭环回报，MiniGrid 的预测一致性实验不计记忆操控能力。既有任务范围保持，训练曲线不是逐模型统一试玩协议。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
note.en: Rechecked control versus world-model diagnostics: Atari100k, Crafter and five ViZDoom scenarios measure closed-loop returns, whereas MiniGrid prediction consistency is not memory-control performance. Retain those bounded units; learning curves are not a uniform model-play protocol. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

note.zh: 完整论文区分 Atari100k 策略评估与 CS:GO 交互生成演示。前者以真实交互预算、逐游戏回报/人类归一化分评价；后者没有可替代原游戏对战胜率的评测，继续只保留 Atari 单位。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
note.en: The full paper separates Atari100k policy evaluation from interactive CS:GO generation. Real-interaction budgets and game/human-normalized returns apply to Atari; CS:GO generation does not supply native-match wins. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

detail.zh: 当前范围已有任务协议，但尚缺将具体任务机制对应到现有能力维度的充分证据；共同交互接口或总体得分不足以代替该依据。
detail.en: Tasks are documented in this scope, but evidence linking their mechanisms to the current capability axes is insufficient. A shared interface or aggregate score does not establish that mapping.

note.zh: 已读取本地作者全文并渲染图 10–11，补齐 Minecraft 与全部 35 个 Atari 实验游戏。Atari 分数可控性作为任务保留，但不强行标成九维能力；机器人任务排除。
note.en: Local author full text and rendered Figures 10–11 resolve Minecraft and all 35 evaluated Atari games. Score steering remains a task without a forced nine-axis label; robotics is excluded.

note.zh: 已读取作者 PDF 并渲染图 4，确认八款实际 PPO 游玩评测游戏；检测 F1/IoU 不计游玩能力，支持清单不等于评测清单。
note.en: Author PDF and rendered Figure 4 establish eight actual PPO gameplay evaluations. Detection F1/IoU and the wider support list are excluded from gameplay coverage.

note.zh: 补入原始 ALE 的实际 RL 评估协议，并将代表子游戏明确挂接；未把所有 ROM 都算作已核验任务。
note.en: Registered the original ALE RL evaluation and explicit representative subgames, without treating every ROM as reviewed.

detail.zh: 该来源在其他游戏或任务上已有协议；当前游戏/大类仍缺直接对应的任务、动作与指标记录，不能继承其他成员的能力。
detail.en: Protocols exist for other games or tasks in this source. This scope still lacks directly linked task/action/metric evidence and cannot inherit sibling capabilities.

note.zh: Crossroads 已确认移动/转向、团队全员到达奖励及种群排名；只将该竞赛协议纳入，不复制到平台其余游戏。
note.en: Crossroads has verified move/turn actions, team-arrival rewards and population rankings; only that race protocol is integrated.

note.zh: ChronoPlay 是游戏知识 RAG 问答与内容时效 benchmark，不属于游戏控制能力覆盖。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: ChronoPlay benchmarks game-domain RAG and information freshness, not gameplay control capabilities. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

note.zh: 编码 Agent 在固定算力内改进世界模型；指标为保留测试集动力学预测质量，不是游戏通关。
note.en: Coding agents improve a world model under fixed compute; held-out dynamics prediction is evaluated, not game completion.

note.zh: 47 项浏览器游戏生成任务；L1/L2 检查通过率与严格任务成功率评价软件实现。
note.en: Forty-seven browser-game generation tasks; L1/L2 pass rates and strict success assess software implementation.

note.zh: Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，评价程序行为正确性；角色动作属于被测程序输出，不是被评估模型的游戏策略。
note.en: Godot logic implementation and repair evaluates program behaviour; character actions are outputs of the implemented software, not the evaluated model’s gameplay policy.

note.zh: GameGen、GameFix、GameOpt 三条开发轨道，评价生成质量、缺陷修复和跨轮优化保真度；不映射到玩家能力。
note.en: GameGen, GameFix and GameOpt assess creation, repair and iterative optimization fidelity, not player capabilities.

note.zh: 正文明确 RL 训练每局抽新种子、最终 checkpoint 在 8 个留出种子评价；三训练种子与 20 人人类实验是不同统计层次。保留已核验八游戏交互单位，未向其他生成变体复制控制能力。
note.en: The paper samples a new training seed each episode and evaluates final checkpoints on eight held-out seeds. Three training seeds and twenty human participants are different statistical levels; retain the eight reviewed games without copying tags to other variants.

note.zh: 247 项 Godot/Unity 开发、修复与迁移任务；执行检查和视觉评分评价游戏产物。
note.en: 247 Godot/Unity construction, repair and porting tasks; runtime checks and visual rubrics evaluate produced games.

note.zh: 截图与视频 QA：视觉单元/回归测试、异常检测和报告生成；没有游戏行动闭环。
note.en: Image/video QA covers visual unit/regression tests, glitches and reports; there is no gameplay action loop.

note.zh: WHAM/Muse 生成、延续和编辑 Bleeding Edge 片段；一致性、多样性、编辑持久性不是玩家通关指标。
note.en: WHAM/Muse generates, continues and edits Bleeding Edge sequences; consistency, diversity and edit persistence are not player completion metrics.

note.zh: 核验全文Execution及附录A.3/B.1，补500任务、75回复预算和屏幕成功验证；只覆盖Execution，不声称Playthrough轨道已同等核验。 本轮归属复核：仅路由500项Execution任务所在的10款游戏。Link’s Awakening的版本未明确，单列研究环境，不合并到现有DX版本；不纳入Playthrough和额外实现游戏。
note.en: Verified Execution and appendices A.3/B.1: 500 tasks, 75-response budgets and screen-based success checks; Playthrough is outside this reviewed scope. Routing review: Route only the ten games supporting 500 Execution tasks. Link’s Awakening edition is unspecified and is not merged with the DX node; Playthrough and extra implementations are excluded.

note.zh: 读取全文§2.3–2.5、§3.1.1，补齐共同动作循环、结果归一化和20局座位平衡；仅集合级单位，未向每子游戏复制能力。 本轮归属复核：表1明确八款实际对局对象；自定义Pong、Surround及Negotiation v2单独建环境，不与Atari版本混同。

note.en: Controls generated video; no native-engine agent goal or completion protocol. Full game roster is not expanded.

note.zh: 编码 Agent 维护世界状态并驱动视频渲染；评价规则一致性和视觉实现，不将世界模拟能力当成玩家能力。
note.en: A coding agent maintains world state and drives video rendering; rule consistency and visual realization are not player capability.

note.zh: VLM 只判定生成画面；未测试 FPS agent 的原生游戏胜负或击杀目标。
note.en: VLM judges generated visuals only; no native FPS agent win/loss or combat-goal evaluation.

note.zh: VLM 是视频评委，不是被测游戏玩家；没有原游戏 goal-driven 在线任务。
note.en: VLM is a video judge, not the tested player. No native-game goal-driven online task.

note.zh: 编码 Agent 在固定算力内改进世界模型；指标为保留测试集动力学预测质量，不是游戏通关。
note.en: Coding agents improve a world model under fixed compute; held-out dynamics prediction is evaluated, not game completion.

note.zh: 47 项浏览器游戏生成任务；L1/L2 检查通过率与严格任务成功率评价软件实现。
note.en: Forty-seven browser-game generation tasks; L1/L2 pass rates and strict success assess software implementation.

note.zh: Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，评价程序行为正确性；角色动作属于被测程序输出，不是被评估模型的游戏策略。
note.en: Godot logic implementation and repair evaluates program behaviour; character actions are outputs of the implemented software, not the evaluated model’s gameplay policy.

note.zh: GameGen、GameFix、GameOpt 三条开发轨道，评价生成质量、缺陷修复和跨轮优化保真度；不映射到玩家能力。
note.en: GameGen, GameFix and GameOpt assess creation, repair and iterative optimization fidelity, not player capabilities.

note.zh: 247 项 Godot/Unity 开发、修复与迁移任务；执行检查和视觉评分评价游戏产物。
note.en: 247 Godot/Unity construction, repair and porting tasks; runtime checks and visual rubrics evaluate produced games.

note.zh: 截图与视频 QA：视觉单元/回归测试、异常检测和报告生成；没有游戏行动闭环。
note.en: Image/video QA covers visual unit/regression tests, glitches and reports; there is no gameplay action loop.

note.zh: WHAM/Muse 生成、延续和编辑 Bleeding Edge 片段；一致性、多样性、编辑持久性不是玩家通关指标。
note.en: WHAM/Muse generates, continues and edits Bleeding Edge sequences; consistency, diversity and edit persistence are not player completion metrics.

note.zh: GameQA 是从游戏生成的可验证视觉推理训练数据；跨域收益不能视为在 30 款游戏中实际游玩的能力覆盖。
note.en: GameQA is verifiable visual-reasoning training data generated from games; transfer gains do not establish interactive play coverage across the 30 source games.

note.zh: 研究从视频预测键盘动作的逆动力学模型；作为方法研究保留，不将模型结构或方法收益直接记作独立基准覆盖。
note.en: Studies inverse-dynamics prediction of key presses from video; retained as method research, without turning architecture or method improvements into independent benchmark coverage.

note.zh: ChronoPlay 是游戏知识 RAG 问答与内容时效 benchmark，不属于游戏控制能力覆盖。 此项不新增独立能力任务。
note.en: ChronoPlay benchmarks game-domain RAG and information freshness, not gameplay control capabilities. No additional independent capability unit is counted.

detail.zh: 当前范围已有任务协议，但尚缺将具体任务机制对应到现有能力维度的充分证据；共同交互接口或总体得分不足以代替该依据。
detail.en: Tasks are documented in this scope, but evidence linking their mechanisms to the current capability axes is insufficient. A shared interface or aggregate score does not establish that mapping.
